Instant-Kill Strike: When opponents enter his En, Nobunaga can draw and strike with such speed that defensive reactions become impossible. The technique is functionally instant at close range.
Warrior's Endurance: Through Enhancement conditioning, Nobunaga can sustain extended combat without fatigue and absorb physical punishment that would incapacitate average fighters.

fighting style: Nobunaga establishes his 4-meter En immediately and waits for opponents to enter. Once they cross the threshold, he draws and executes the instant-kill strike. Against opponents fast enough to react, he transitions to rapid sword strikes emphasizing speed and momentum. He favors aggressive engagement and does not typically retreat or evade. His combat style is direct and brutal—he overpowers opponents through superior speed and strength rather than complex tactics. His emotional investment in Troupe loyalty sometimes causes him to take unnecessary risks to protect other members. Against vastly superior opponents, he fights to the death rather than flee, viewing survival without honor as unacceptable.

Feitan Portor.name: Feitan Portor
Feitan Portor.basicInfo: A small, reserved figure whose quiet demeanor masks the Troupe's most sadistic member, Feitan is an expert torturer and Transmuter of exceptional power. He is a diminutive man of slight build with sallow pale skin, sharp rat-like features, black hair, and dark unreadable eyes. He wears dark gloves perpetually, precise dark formal clothing, and a red or purple coat, presenting an almost prissy appearance that contradicts his vicious capabilities.
personality: Methodical: approaches torture and violence with scientific precision, treating suffering as a craft to be perfected
Reserved: speaks minimally and often in broken syntax, yet his words carry significant weight when he does communicate
Sadistic: derives genuine satisfaction from inflicting pain and observing prolonged suffering in victims
Emotionless: maintains absolute emotional distance from victims, viewing them as objects rather than people
Feitan Portor.hiddenInfo: Feitan is the Troupe's #2 and its primary interrogator-torturer. His Nen category is Transmutation, and his signature ability is Pain Packer: Rising Sun—a Hatsu that converts his accumulated pain into a burning sun-like aura that explodes outward with tremendous destructive force. The more pain Feitan absorbs during combat, the more powerful his Rising Sun becomes, making him stronger the longer he endures injuries. This paradoxical ability rewards defensive commitment and punishment absorption. Beyond Rising Sun, Feitan is a skilled fighter capable of rapid strikes and excellent mobility despite his small size. His torture techniques are legendary within criminal underworld circles—targets under his care frequently confess secrets within hours, though many do not survive the experience. In certain arcs, when Chrollo's Nen is sealed, Feitan assumes interim leadership of the Troupe, demonstrating that he possesses strategic depth beyond torture and violence. His greatest secret is his background: Feitan comes from a region with non-standard Nen theory, explaining his broken syntax and unusual ability mechanics. His past is deliberately shrouded in mystery. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 active and operational; A5-A7 continues membership; A8 aboard Black Whale; in specific arc-dependent states, may temporarily lead when Chrollo is incapacitated.
abilities: Pain Packer: Rising Sun: Feitan's signature ability converts accumulated pain into a destructive burning aura that he can release as an explosion. The longer he sustains injury without using the ability, the more powerful the eventual release becomes.
Transmutation Mastery: Feitan transmutes his aura into various forms for offense and defense, creating cutting auras, defensive barriers, and precision striking techniques.
Rapid Strikes: Despite his small frame, Feitan is exceptionally fast, capable of launching rapid hand-to-hand combinations that overwhelm opponents through sheer tempo.

Torture Expertise: Feitan possesses encyclopedic knowledge of human anatomy and psychological manipulation, allowing him to extract information or inflict maximal suffering through calculated technique.
Combat Resilience: Feitan's Pain Packer incentivizes absorbing damage, making him psychologically capable of sustaining injuries that would break other fighters' willpower.

fighting style: Feitan fights by absorbing damage and accumulating pain for a devastating Rising Sun release. Against impatient opponents, he intentionally provokes strikes, drawing aggression and building his sun's power. He uses rapid mobility to evade critical blows while accepting non-lethal damage. His strategy requires psychological fortitude—he must remain composed while injured and dangerous. Against opponents who recognize his ability and refuse to strike him, he becomes more aggressive, actively pursuing combat to damage opponents or forcing them to engage him. His greatest strength is his counterintuitive mechanic—damage makes him more dangerous. His greatest weakness is overcommitment to this strategy against opponents capable of one-shot kills, where accumulating power becomes irrelevant.

Machi Komacine.name: Machi Komacine
Machi Komacine.basicInfo: A skilled surgical Nen user whose mastery of thread-based manipulation makes her indispensable to the Troupe, Machi combines clinical precision with an unsettling calm. She is a slender woman with striking pink hair, pale skin, sharp intelligent features, and observant dark eyes that miss nothing. She typically wears revealing clothing—a sleeveless vest, short skirt, and boots—suggesting a warrior confident in her ability to handle any threat.
personality: Pragmatic: approaches problems methodically, assessing situations for the most efficient solution regardless of emotional considerations
Intuitive: possesses exceptional instincts about people and situations, trusting her gut more than logical analysis
Controlled: maintains emotional composure and perfect professional distance even in chaotic situations
Subtly sarcastic: communicates with dry wit and understated humor that can be lost on those unfamiliar with her style
Machi Komacine.hiddenInfo: Machi is the Troupe's #3 and its primary medic and logistics operator. Her Nen category is Transmutation, and her signature ability involves conjuring and manipulating fine Nen threads with surgical precision. She uses these threads to sew wounds closed (capable of suturing severe injuries rapidly), create restraints, and establish tracking threads that allow her to monitor people remotely. Her intuition is trusted implicitly by the Troupe—when Machi senses something is wrong or advises caution, members take her seriously. She has complicated feelings about Hisoka: she knows his spider tattoo is fake, but she regards him with a mixture of attraction and wariness that keeps her relationship with him unpredictable and tense. During the Yorknew arc, she participates fully in the auction massacre and fake-death operation, cementing her role as a core member. Her greatest secret is the extent of her emotional investment in certain members—particularly her genuine concern for Pakunoda before her sacrifice, which Machi rarely voices but which shapes her decisions. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 active and operational; A5-A7 continues membership; A8 aboard Black Whale hunting Hisoka.
abilities: Nen Thread Conjuration: Machi conjures thin, nearly invisible threads from her aura that possess supernatural durability. She can manipulate them with precision for surgical stitching, restraints, or detection.

Surgical Thread Work: Machi's threads can sew severe wounds closed with perfection, allowing rapid battlefield triage. She can seal internal injuries and restore functional capability to damaged bodies.
Tracking Threads: Machi can place invisible threads on targets that allow her to sense their location and movement remotely. Multiple tracking threads can be maintained simultaneously.
Thread Restraints: Her threads can create unbreakable bonds capable of restraining even enhanced Nen users. The restraints are invisible until deliberately revealed.
Aura Sensing Intuition: Beyond technical ability, Machi possesses exceptional intuition about aura and danger. Her instincts about threats or deception are remarkably accurate.

fighting style: Machi prefers ranged engagement using her threads, maintaining distance while establishing restraints or delivering precision strikes. She rarely commits to close combat unless forced. Her combat style emphasizes control and setup—she establishes thread networks that limit opponent movement, then attacks from safe distance. Against multiple opponents, she uses threads to separate and isolate them. Against physically superior opponents, she avoids direct engagement and instead uses threads defensively. Her greatest strength is her adaptability—she transitions fluidly between offense, defense, and support roles. Her greatest weakness is her reliance on established thread networks; against opponents who destroy or neutralize her threads, she becomes significantly weaker.

Phinks Magcub.name: Phinks Magcub
Phinks Magcub.basicInfo: A powerfully-built fighter of Egyptian inspiration whose explosive strength makes him one of the Troupe's most direct offensive assets, Phinks is a barrel-chested man of above-average height with dark brown skin, close-cropped black hair, sharp features, and intense eyes. He wears a tracksuit typically in earth tones or bright colors, athletic shoes, and numerous golden rings and chains, giving him a striking street-athlete appearance.
personality: Aggressive: favors direct confrontation and explosive action over subtle tactics or patience
Competitive: constantly compares himself to other Troupe members and pushes to prove his relative strength
Boisterous: expresses himself with enthusiasm and volume; his presence fills whatever space he occupies
Loyal but volatile: devoted to the Troupe but prone to friction with members he perceives as rivals or threats
Phinks Magcub.hiddenInfo: Phinks is the Troupe's #5 and its specialist in raw offensive power. His Nen category is Enhancement, and his signature ability is Ripper Cyclotron—a technique where he winds his arm in rapid circular motions, accumulating kinetic energy. The longer he winds, the more powerful his eventual strike becomes, allowing him to generate devastating punches capable of obliterating opponents and structures. The windups are visible and time-consuming, making the technique dependent on getting uninterrupted setup time. Phinks is extremely competitive with other strong members of the Troupe and often initiates combat to test his relative power. He views strength as the primary metric of worth, and he has genuine respect for members like Uvogin and Franklin who demonstrate overwhelming force. His competitive nature occasionally puts him at odds with quieter, subtler members who accomplish objectives through strategy rather than power. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 active and operational; A5-A7 continues membership; A8 aboard Black Whale hunting Hisoka.
abilities: Ripper Cyclotron Acceleration: Phinks winds his arm in rapid circles, accumulating rotational kinetic energy. Each rotation increases the power of his eventual strike exponentially.
Cyclotron Strike: Once he releases the accumulated energy, Phinks delivers a punch of tremendous force capable of shattering reinforced structures and penetrating defensive auras.
Enhanced Strength: As an Enhancer, Phinks reinforces his body with aura, granting him exceptional strength even without his Cyclotron technique. His baseline strength exceeds most fighters'.
Aggressive Mobility: Phinks moves with surprising speed for his bulky frame, using explosive footwork to close distance and overwhelm opponents.
Endurance: Through Enhancement conditioning, Phinks can sustain high-intensity combat for extended periods without fatigue.

fighting style: Phinks charges at opponents aggressively, either closing distance for direct strikes or spinning up his Cyclotron ability. He prefers continuous pressure and overwhelming force over tactical subtlety. He creates openings through sheer aggression, forcing opponents to react defensively while he sets up his devastating punches. Against opponents faster than him, he becomes frustrated and more aggressive, sometimes losing tactical judgment. Against comparable strength opponents, he demonstrates he can adapt to sustained competition. His greatest strength is his explosive power and willingness to engage directly. His greatest weakness is his Cyclotron's wind-up time—opponents who prevent him from spinning up can neutralize his most dangerous technique.

Franklin Bordeau.name: Franklin Bordeau
Franklin Bordeau.basicInfo: A massive, scarred giant whose calm demeanor masks tremendous destructive capability, Franklin is one of the Troupe's most powerful and principled members. He is an enormous man of imposing stature with dark skin, extensive facial and body scars from countless contracts, large gentle eyes, and short dark hair. He wears minimal clothing—often just suspenders over his bare muscular chest—displaying the scars as evidence of his lethal experience.
personality: Principled: maintains a consistent moral code regarding the Troupe's operations and holds other members accountable to agreed-upon rules
Quiet: speaks rarely, and when he does, his words carry significant weight due to his reputation and demonstrated competence
Melancholic: carries an underlying sadness suggesting deep moral conflict about the violence he commits
Protective: shows genuine concern for other Troupe members and willingly sacrifices personal advantage to ensure their safety
Franklin Bordeau.hiddenInfo: Franklin is the Troupe's #7 and its quiet conscience—the member most likely to argue against unnecessary cruelty or operations that violate the Troupe's internal ethics code. His Nen category is Emission, and his signature ability is Double Machine Gun—a technique where he converts aura into high-speed bullets that fire from his fingertips with gatling-gun rapidity. Early in his career, Franklin literally cut off his own fingertips as a vow to strengthen his ability, using his shed fingers as the foundation for his Nen projectile enhancement. This self-sacrifice created a permanent condition (he has no fingertips) that he maintains through Nen reinforcement. Beyond his obvious power, Franklin is the Troupe's moral anchor—he is the member most likely to express doubt about certain operations and the one members defer to when ethical questions arise. His greatest secret is his genuine belief that the Troupe's violence is necessary but his personal hope that the cycle can eventually end. This philosophical depth distinguishes him from members who enjoy violence for its own sake. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 active and operational; A5-A7 continues membership; A8 aboard Black Whale hunting Hisoka.
abilities: Double Machine Gun Emission: Franklin converts his aura into high-speed projectiles that fire from his fingertips with gatling-gun speed. The bullets possess tremendous force capable of piercing armor and structures.

Fingertip Vow: Franklin's self-sacrifice (cutting off his own fingertips) permanently strengthened his Double Machine Gun ability. The vow creates a mechanical limitation—he cannot recover his fingertips—but grants exceptional power.
Aura Bullet Control: Franklin can fire in patterns, adjust trajectory, and coordinate multi-directional fire. His control allows precision targeting despite the rapid rate of fire.
Physical Fortitude: As a veteran of countless contracts, Franklin's body is conditioned to absorb tremendous punishment. His scars represent lethal encounters survived.
Strategic Restraint: Franklin possesses the discipline to limit his firepower when tactical situations call for controlled engagement rather than overwhelming force.

fighting style: Franklin establishes distance and uses his Double Machine Gun for constant harassment and area denial. He creates suppressive fire that forces opponents into movement patterns he can predict. Against weaker opponents, he overwhelms with continuous fire; against strong opponents, he uses fire to manage distance and prevent closing. His combat style emphasizes control through overwhelming volume rather than precision. He rarely engages in close combat, preferring to maintain distance where his gatling-gun technique is most effective. His moral nature sometimes causes him to limit his firepower in ways that other members would not, creating potential vulnerability. His greatest strength is his raw destructive capacity and psychological presence—opponents facing Franklin's gatling fire experience genuine psychological pressure. His greatest weakness is his reluctance to kill unnecessarily, which thoughtful opponents can exploit.

Shalnark.name: Shalnark
Shalnark.basicInfo: A cheerful, tech-savvy blond whose disarmingly friendly demeanor contradicts his deadly efficiency, Shalnark is a young man with pale skin, shoulder-length blonde hair, bright cheerful eyes, and an easy smile. He typically wears casual modern clothing—a tank top, baggy pants, and sneakers—alongside technological gadgets and antennae-like appendages on his head suggesting cybernetic enhancement.
personality: Cheerful: genuinely enjoys social interaction and expresses enthusiasm for most activities, making him approachable compared to darker Troupe members
Technically minded: passionate about technology and innovation; often tinkers with devices or conceptualizes improvements to existing tools
Surprisingly ruthless: beneath his friendly exterior lies absolute willingness to kill, torture, and betray without hesitation when the Troupe demands it
Impulsive: acts on impulses and enthusiasm without always considering consequences; his carefree nature masks dangerous unpredictability
Shalnark.hiddenInfo: Shalnark is the Troupe's #6 and its technology specialist. His Nen category is Manipulation, and his signature ability is Black Voice—antennae-like appendages conjured from aura that allow him to take mental control of other Nen users. Once his antennae attach to a target's body, Shalnark gains absolute control over their actions, movements, and abilities. The technique is devastating but requires direct physical contact to initiate. Beyond Black Voice, Shalnark is skilled in technology and maintains gadgets for the Troupe's operations. His fatal vulnerability: Shalnark is murdered during the Succession War arc (A8) by the revived Hisoka, who appears during the Troupe's aboard-the-Whale hunt for revenge. Shalnark's death marks the beginning of Hisoka's systematic destruction of the Troupe's membership. His cheerful nature makes his death poignant—a reminder that friendliness offers no protection against lethal opponents. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 active and operational; A5-A7 continues membership; A8 early only (dies mid-arc to Hisoka, murdered, does not appear thereafter).
abilities: Black Voice Antennae: Shalnark conjures antennae-like appendages from his aura that can attach to other Nen users' bodies, granting him absolute mental control over their actions and abilities.
Motor Control Override: Once Black Voice antennae are attached, Shalnark can command any physical action, overriding the target's autonomy completely.
Ability Activation Control: Shalnark can force targets to activate their Hatsu abilities, making him capable of weaponizing other Nen users against their will.
Technology Integration: Shalnark maintains and operates specialized technology for Troupe operations, including communications systems and surveillance devices.

Autopilot Mode: Shalnark developed an autopilot mode where he can place himself in a trance state, allowing his body to execute combat protocols independently while his consciousness rests. This mode is dangerous because his unconscious body makes unpredictable decisions.

fighting style: Shalnark prioritizes establishing Black Voice antennae contact, which immediately neutralizes opponents by removing their autonomy. Before antennae contact is made, he relies on acrobatic evasion and ranged Nen projection to avoid damage. Once control is established, he can force targets to fight their allies or incapacitate themselves. His greatest vulnerability is the contact requirement—opponents who prevent him from touching them can avoid Black Voice entirely. His autopilot mode is unreliable and dangerous, sometimes causing him to take unnecessary risks or attack allies. His cheerful personality sometimes delays his deployment of lethal force, creating tactical windows. His greatest strength is his ability to neutralize opponents through control rather than direct combat.

Shizuku Murasaki.name: Shizuku Murasaki
Shizuku Murasaki.basicInfo: A woman of absent-minded demeanor and supernatural vacuuming ability, Shizuku possesses an uncanny disconnection from normal social context. She is a slender woman with dark skin, dark hair typically covered by a headband, black-framed glasses, and a perpetually distant expression suggesting her consciousness exists elsewhere. She wears casual clothing—a loose shirt and simple pants—and is usually accompanied by a small sentient vacuum she uses as a tool.
personality: Absent-minded: frequently forgets recent events, people's names, and previous conversations; her memory operates selectively and unpredictably
Innocent: possesses childlike innocence about violence and morality, treating killing as casual as organizing objects
Observant of triviality: focuses intently on minor details while missing obvious major context, creating a skewed perspective on situations
Quirky speech: speaks matter-of-factly about disturbing topics without emotional affect, making casual conversation unsettling
Shizuku Murasaki.hiddenInfo: Shizuku is the Troupe's #8 and its logistics coordinator. Her Nen category is Conjuration, and her signature ability is Blinky—a sentient vacuum creature she conjured from pure aura. Blinky possesses an appetite for what Shizuku considers "trash," which she defines subjectively; Blinky will swallow nearly anything she points to, storing it internally. Critically, Blinky will not consume living things that Shizuku remembers or has formed emotional attachment to—this limitation creates her only moral constraint. Her amnesia is genuine and disabling; she frequently forgets Troupe members' names, recent missions, and previous conversations, making her unreliable for complex operations but invaluable for simple task execution. Her disconnection from normal social context makes her both harmless-seeming and genuinely dangerous—she will execute orders without hesitation because she often forgets what the orders entail between execution and completion. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 active and operational; A5-A7 continues membership; A8 aboard Black Whale hunting Hisoka.
abilities: Blinky Conjuration: Shizuku conjured a sentient vacuum creature (Blinky) from pure aura. Blinky possesses an insatiable appetite for items Shizuku designates as "trash," swallowing them into its interdimensional storage.

Selective Appetite: Blinky will not consume living things that Shizuku remembers or has emotional attachment to. This creates Shizuku's only genuine moral limitation—she cannot weaponize Blinky against friends.
Storage Capacity: Blinky's internal storage appears limitless; it has consumed massive items, entire structures, and vast quantities of material without showing capacity limits.
Trash Designation Authority: Shizuku possesses absolute authority over what Blinky considers trash. She can expand or contract the definition subjectively.
Vacuum Locomotion: Blinky is mobile and responsive to Shizuku's commands, following her instructions and moving independently through environments.

fighting style: Shizuku does not fight directly—she relies on Blinky to incapacitate and remove obstacles from her path. She is vulnerable in personal combat due to her lack of physical training. Her value lies in logistics and problem-solving (consuming obstacles or storing vital objects). Against opponents she remembers or has formed attachment to, she becomes paralyzed because she cannot weaponize Blinky. Against opponents she considers "trash," she can eliminate them through Blinky consumption. Her amnesia makes her unpredictable; she sometimes forgets she's in combat. Her greatest strength is Blinky's versatility; her greatest weakness is her personal fragility and mental disconnection from reality.

Pakunoda.name: Pakunoda
Pakunoda.basicInfo: A sharp-suited woman of striking presence whose memories flow like tangible things, Pakunoda is an elegant figure combining professional tailoring with lethal capability. She is a woman of dark skin, sharp features, alert intelligent eyes, and dark hair, typically wearing a sharp suit jacket, precise slacks, and formal shoes giving her an almost corporate appearance contrasting her Troupe membership.
personality: Professional: approaches all tasks with business-like efficiency; her demeanor is courteous and measured regardless of violence involved
Intellectually sharp: possesses keen analytical ability; she reads people and situations with impressive accuracy
Loyal to the Troupe: genuine devotion to the collective, though her loyalty does not extend to specific members beyond professional respect
Direct and blunt: speaks plainly without diplomatic softening; her honesty sometimes creates friction with sensitive members
Pakunoda.hiddenInfo: Pakunoda is the Troupe's #9 and its intelligence gatherer. Her Nen category is Specialist, and her signature ability is Memory Reading—she can touch a target's body and extract their memories, experiencing them as vividly as the original subject. This ability makes her invaluable for intelligence gathering and interrogation; she can determine truth, discover secrets, and understand enemy plans through direct memory access. Her counterpart ability is Memory Bomb, a technique where she condenses gathered memories into projectiles that explode on impact, dispersing the memories into nearby observers—effectively weaponizing information. Pakunoda's greatest sacrifice occurs at the end of the Yorknew arc: captured by enemy forces while protecting Gon and Killua (whom she had read memories from earlier), she activates Memory Bomb on herself, dispersing her memories and those of other Troupe members to the captured members. This sacrifice kills her, severing the Troupe's internal secrecy about member identities. Her death marks the arc's emotional climax and demonstrates her willingness to sacrifice herself for the Troupe's survival. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 active and operational; A4 end dies via Memory Bomb self-sacrifice (captures and released immediately after); A5-A8 dead, never appears.
abilities: Memory Reading Touch: Pakunoda can touch a target and extract their memories, experiencing them with perfect clarity and sensory detail. She gains complete knowledge of the subject's past experiences.
Memory Accuracy: Her extracted memories are perfectly accurate; she experiences exactly what the target experienced from their perspective, making deception impossible.
Memory Bomb Condensation: Pakunoda can compress extracted memories into tangible projectiles that detonate on impact, dispersing memories to nearby observers.
Multiple Target Reading: Pakunoda can read memories from multiple people in succession, building a comprehensive intelligence picture from combined information.
Aura Resilience: Through professional conditioning, Pakunoda maintains psychological resilience against the emotional weight of reading disturbing memories.

fighting style: Pakunoda is not primarily a combatant; her value lies in intelligence gathering and memory-based weapons. In direct combat, she avoids engagement and uses Memory Bombs as area-denial weapons. Her bombs can eliminate multiple opponents by dispersing memories that disorient and psychologically damage targets. Against prepared opponents, she seeks memory extraction on peripheral targets, then uses those memories strategically. Her greatest strength is her information advantage; her greatest weakness is her lack of personal combat training—direct physical engagement overwhelms her quickly. Her self-sacrifice at the end of Yorknew marks her arc's completion: she chooses Troupe loyalty over survival.

Uvogin.name: Uvogin
Uvogin.basicInfo: A mountain of a man whose massive frame and explosive strength make him the Troupe's primary melee devastation asset, Uvogin is an imposing figure of raw physical presence. He is an enormous man of incredible muscularity with very dark skin, a shaved head, a prominent jaw with a slight underbite, intense dark eyes, and numerous scars across his body and face. He wears minimal clothing—typically just pants and heavy boots—displaying his massive frame without constraint.
personality: Aggressive: actively seeks combat and views fighting as the primary problem-solving method
Honorable: respects worthy opponents and fights with professional codes about challenge and legitimate conquest
Emotionally direct: expresses feelings openly; his grief over deaths of Troupe members is visible and genuine
Confident bordering on arrogant: believes his strength is unquestionable and is shocked when challenged by comparable opponents
Uvogin.hiddenInfo: Uvogin is the Troupe's #11 and arguably its most physically powerful member—a mountain of muscle and aura whose enhancement capability borders on superhuman. His Nen category is Enhancement, and his signature ability is Big Bang Impact—a technique where he throws a massive punch that creates a shockwave of destructive force capable of obliterating buildings and vast areas. The ability's power scales with his emotional intensity; his most powerful strikes occur when he fights for revenge or to defend Troupe honor. Uvogin's emotional investment in the Troupe is genuine; he forms real bonds with members and grieves their deaths sincerely. His fatal vulnerability: Uvogin dies at the end of the Yorknew City arc, defeated by Kurapika's Judgment Chain ability. During their confrontation, Kurapika's Scarlet Eyes activate (triggered by Uvogin being a Troupe member), transforming Kurapika into a Specialist capable of sealing Uvogin's Nen permanently. Uvogin cannot adapt or escape the curse; he dies bound by chains that prevent his aura from flowing. His death devastates Nobunaga and marks the first major Troupe casualty in the narrative. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 active and operational; A4 end dies to Kurapika's Judgment Chain curse; A5-A8 dead, never appears.
abilities: Big Bang Impact Shockwave: Uvogin throws a devastating punch that creates a massive shockwave extending far beyond his physical reach. The attack obliterates structures and causes devastating area damage.
Impact Scaling: The power of Big Bang Impact scales with Uvogin's emotional intensity. Defensive or revenge-motivated strikes achieve maximum power.
Enhanced Durability: As an Enhancer, Uvogin reinforces his entire body with aura, making him nearly impervious to physical trauma and capable of surviving impacts that would destroy normal humans.
Overwhelming Strength: Uvogin's baseline physical strength exceeds virtually all other fighters; he can carry or throw objects of impossible weight and destroy barriers through brute force.
Aggressive Presence: Uvogin's sheer physical dominance creates psychological pressure on opponents; his appearance alone intimidates.

fighting style: Uvogin charges directly at opponents using Big Bang Impact repeatedly, trusting his overwhelming strength and durability to overwhelm resistance. He does not employ subtle tactics or complex strategy; he simply applies more force than opponents can withstand. Against weaker opponents, he crushes them with minimal effort. Against comparable strength opponents, he demonstrates technical skill and controlled strikes. He becomes frustrated against opponents who evade rather than engage, as his combat style depends on direct confrontation. His emotional nature makes him predictable for opponents who understand how to provoke him. His greatest strength is his raw destructive power; his greatest weakness is his reliance on direct engagement against opponents capable of sealing his Nen or preventing impact damage through defensive techniques.

Bonolenov Ndongo.name: Bonolenov Ndongo
Bonolenov Ndongo.basicInfo: A warrior-dancer whose entire body is wrapped in bandages and whose Nen abilities manifest through musical performance, Bonolenov is an enigmatic figure suggesting hidden depths beneath layers of cloth. He appears as a heavily-bandaged figure with only his eyes visible through gaps in the wrappings; his exact physical form remains concealed. He moves with fluid, rhythmic grace suggesting dance or martial discipline despite the restrictive bandaging.
personality: Mysterious: deliberately conceals personal information and true identity; little is known about his background or motivations
Artistic: views combat as performance art; his Nen abilities manifest through musical and rhythmic expression
Disciplined: maintains rigorous protocols about his body, bandaging, and ritual preparation for combat
Socially distant: interacts minimally with other Troupe members; his communication is sparse and formal
Bonolenov Ndongo.hiddenInfo: Bonolenov is the Troupe's #10 and one of its most mysterious members. His Nen category is Conjuration, and his signature ability is Battle Cantabile—a technique where his body piercings function as wind instruments that produce sounds capable of manifesting conjured constructs (notably Jupiter, a massive conjured planet). Each piercing produces different notes; coordinated playing creates complex conjurations with devastating power. The exact mechanism by which sound translates to conjured matter remains unclear, suggesting Bonolenov comes from a non-standard Nen tradition. His bandaging serves both practical and philosophical purposes—it protects his body and conceals his true appearance. His background is deliberately vague; he is known primarily through his actions rather than personal revelation. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 active and operational; A5-A7 continues membership; A8 aboard Black Whale hunting Hisoka.
abilities: Battle Cantabile Instrument Piercings: Bonolenov's body piercings function as wind instruments, each producing distinct musical notes that manifest conjured constructs through sound.
Jupiter Conjuration: By coordinating multiple piercings in specific patterns, Bonolenov can conjure Jupiter—a massive planet-sized construct capable of devastating area attacks.
Sound-Based Manifestation: The relationship between musical sound and conjured matter is non-standard, suggesting Bonolenov's Nen training comes from an unconventional tradition.
Bandage Integration: Bonolenov's bandages function as part of his Nen combat system; he can manipulate them as additional weapons or defensive tools.
Mystical Resilience: Despite his apparently fragile bandaged appearance, Bonolenov is physically durable, suggesting internal reinforcement or Nen-based body modification.

fighting style: Bonolenov maintains distance while playing his piercings to conjure battlefield-altering constructs. He coordinates different piercing combinations to create layered defenses and offensive manifestations. Against opponents who prevent him from playing, he transitions to close-combat using bandage manipulation and physical techniques. His combat philosophy emphasizes environmental control and conjured superiority rather than personal physical prowess. His greatest strength is his devastating Jupiter ability; his greatest weakness is his reliance on uninterrupted playing—opponents who disrupt his sound production can neutralize his primary offense.

Kortopi.name: Kortopi
Kortopi.basicInfo: A diminutive figure whose unassuming appearance masks exceptional Nen capability, Kortopi is a small man with a mop-like head of unkempt hair, dark skin, innocent-seeming features, and a body that suggests youth or underdevelopment. He typically wears simple, casual clothing—a loose shirt and simple pants—presenting an almost childlike appearance that belies his lethal Nen mastery.
personality: Quiet: speaks minimally and observes more than participates in group dynamics
Focused: maintains concentration on specific tasks; he approaches objectives with tunnel-vision dedication
Socially awkward: struggles with casual conversation and social cues; his interactions are stilted and uncomfortable
Proud of craft: displays subtle pride in his copying ability, though he rarely boasts or claims credit
Kortopi.hiddenInfo: Kortopi is the Troupe's #12 and its specialist in copying and counterfeiting. His Nen category is Conjuration, and his signature ability is Gallery Fake—a technique allowing him to create perfect 24-hour copies of any object he touches with his left hand. The copy possesses all properties of the original and functions identically; after 24 hours, the copy dissipates. The original must be touched by his left hand to initiate copying; his right hand is used to produce the copy. This mechanic creates powerful applications for currency duplication, artifact creation, and deception. Kortopi's fatal vulnerability: he is murdered during the Succession War arc (A8) by the revived Hisoka, who targets him as part of his systematic destruction of the Troupe. Kortopi's death, alongside Shalnark's, marks Hisoka's serious campaign of revenge against the organization. Kortopi's small, unassuming nature makes his death particularly poignant—he was never a major threat to Hisoka, yet he is eliminated regardless, demonstrating Hisoka's systematic brutality. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 active and operational; A5-A7 continues membership; A8 early only (dies mid-arc to Hisoka, murdered, does not appear thereafter).
abilities: Gallery Fake Copying: Kortopi can touch an object with his left hand and conjure a perfect 24-hour duplicate from his right hand. The duplicate possesses all properties of the original and is functionally identical.
Object Duplication Versatility: Gallery Fake works on any object—currency, artifacts, weapons, complex mechanisms—allowing Kortopi to create duplicates of nearly anything.
Time-Limited Copies: Each duplicate automatically dissipates after exactly 24 hours, creating a temporal limitation that requires frequent recopying.
Perfect Reproduction: The copies are perfect in every way—they fool detection methods, pass physical tests, and function exactly as originals.
Rapid Deployment: Kortopi can create multiple copies in succession, allowing him to produce large quantities of duplicated material.

fighting style: Kortopi is not a combat specialist; his value lies entirely in his copying ability. In direct combat, he is vulnerable—he lacks combat training and physical conditioning. He typically avoids confrontation and relies on other Troupe members for protection during dangerous situations. His Gallery Fake ability can be weaponized (copying weapons or explosives), but he is not skilled at direct application. His greatest strength is his utility value—his ability enables the Troupe's financial independence and logistical flexibility. His greatest weakness is his personal fragility; a direct fighter of modest capability can eliminate him in personal combat.

Biscuit Krueger.name: Biscuit Krueger
Biscuit Krueger.basicInfo: A legendary double-star Stone Hunter of fifty-seven years whose true form contradicts her deceptive appearance, Biscuit masquerades as a sweet twelve-year-old child in frilly pink attire—a disguise that conceals her actual muscular physique and ruthless training methods. Despite her youthful presentation, her eyes carry the weight of decades of experience and her voice carries maternal authority beneath its childlike pitch. She wears deliberately cutesy pink clothing with bows and ribbons, playing the role of young girl to perfection.
personality: Patient mentorship: takes time to develop her students' understanding rather than rushing results
Perfectionistic: demands absolute precision and refuses to accept mediocrity from those she trains
Theatrical deception: maintains her child disguise with complete commitment, never breaking character
Candid and direct: beneath her disguise, speaks with brutal honesty about her students' capabilities and shortcomings
Biscuit Krueger.hiddenInfo: Biscuit Krueger is a double-star Stone Hunter who specializes in searching for and analyzing stones of value—her expertise made her invaluable to Ging's Greed Island game masters. Her true form is that of a mountain of muscle and raw physical power, a physique she despises and deliberately hides beneath a sophisticated illusion that presents her as a sweet twelve-year-old child. This transformation is genuine and complete—when she removes the disguise (rare and traumatic), her actual body emerges. Her Nen category is Transmutation, and she possesses the 'Magical Esthetician: Cookie-chan' ability, which allows her to perform deep tissue massage and aura restoration, healing injuries and fatigue in those she trains. She served as Wing's protégé in the past, learning the foundational Nen techniques from him, and she became a legendary trainer through her brutal but effective methods. In the Greed Island arc (A5), she poses as 'Bisky,' befriends Gon and Killua, and pushes them through agonizing Ren and physical conditioning training that accelerates their growth by months. Her maternal side emerges through training—she cares deeply for her students but refuses to soften the difficulty of the work. ARC VALIDITY: A1-A4 background (Hunter Association Stone Hunter); A5 central (Greed Island trainer); A6-A8 references as legendary trainer.
abilities: Transmutation Mastery: Biscuit transforms her aura with exceptional precision, allowing for both offensive techniques and the healing capability of Cookie-chan.

Magical Esthetician—Cookie-chan: Biscuit's signature Hatsu allows her to perform restorative massage that heals injuries, restores aura, and alleviates fatigue in those she touches. The technique requires physical contact and sustained effort but is remarkably effective.
Disguise Technique: Biscuit maintains a complete physical transformation that presents her as a young child. This transformation is genuine—her actual body is hidden, not merely masked.
Advanced Ren Training: Biscuit is a master teacher of fundamental Nen techniques, capable of identifying student weaknesses and designing targeted training regimens.
Mineral Expertise: As a Stone Hunter, Biscuit possesses encyclopedic knowledge of stones, gems, and geological formations—she can identify rare stones instantly and assess their value.
Physical Conditioning: Beneath her disguise, Biscuit possesses tremendous physical strength developed through decades of rigorous self-training and Stone hunting expeditions.

fighting style: Biscuit fights with overwhelming physical power when forced to reveal her true form, leveraging her mountain-like musculature and years of combat experience. In her child disguise, she avoids direct combat, preferring to teach or withdraw. Her true combat style involves transforming her aura through Transmutation to create powerful strikes and defensive capabilities. She is notably patient—she observes opponent tactics before committing to strategy, adapting her approach based on what she learns. Her greatest strength is her experience and refusal to be underestimated—opponents who dismiss 'a child' often commit fatal errors. Her weakness is minimal when fighting seriously; her only limitation is her reluctance to abandon her disguise except in absolute emergencies.

Razor.name: Razor
Razor.basicInfo: A colossal dreadlocked colossus of a man with deep dark skin and an aura of sportsmanlike menace, Razor combines physical enormity with surprising gentleness of manner. He possesses a massive muscular frame standing over seven feet tall, with long dreadlocked hair, intense dark eyes, and a broad face marked by scarification. He wears simple practical clothing—loose dark shirts and pants that accommodate his immense frame—and carries himself with the bearing of a natural apex predator.
personality: Sportsmanlike honor: views competition as sacred; respects worthy opponents and keeps his word absolutely
Laid-back: maintains calm demeanor despite his intimidating presence; rarely shows aggression unless provoked
Playful: finds enjoyment in games and challenges, taking pleasure in testing strong opponents fairly
Directly honest: speaks plainly without deception; his word is his bond
Razor.hiddenInfo: Razor is one of Ging Freecss's original eleven game masters, a position reserved for fighters of exceptional capability whom Ging personally selected and trusted. His true name and history are less documented than most masters; what is known is that he was a death-row convict before Ging recruited him—a brutal criminal offered redemption through the game. His Nen category is Emission, and his primary technique is the creation of explosive aura constructs employed in deadly dodgeball. His signature ability is the 'Nen Dodgeball' game where he and other masters use Emission to weaponize a simple ball, making it a tool of lethal force. Beyond this, Razor is capable of creating Nen constructs—the 'Fourteen Devils' are his conjured demons, spiritual entities bound to his will. His relationship with other game masters is collegial; he respects them as peers and enforces the rules of the Greed Island game with absolute fairness. His fight against Hisoka (an alliance of Gon, Killua, and Hisoka united temporarily for dodgeball) became legendary—his defeat was a shock to both other masters and players. ARC VALIDITY: A5 featured (Greed Island game master); A6-A8 background references.
abilities: Nen Dodgeball Mastery: Razor's primary technique employs Emission to weaponize a simple ball. The ball becomes a projectile of tremendous force, capable of causing serious injury or death.

Fourteen Devils Conjuration: Razor can summon fourteen Nen-constructed demon entities ('devils') bound to his will. These creatures possess independent agency within limits and can engage in combat on his behalf.
Emission Mastery: Razor possesses exceptional control of aura projection, allowing him to maintain multiple constructs simultaneously and create explosive effects from distance.
Supernatural Strength: Razor's physical frame grants him strength far exceeding human norms. He can throw objects (including living opponents) with casual ease.
Durability Embodiment: Razor's massive body absorbs tremendous punishment; his physical construction makes him difficult to injure through conventional means.
Game Mastery Knowledge: Razor understands the full mechanics of Greed Island and possesses intimate knowledge of all game rules, card interactions, and spell mechanics.

fighting style: Razor fights with a player's mindset—he approaches combat as a game where victory is achieved through fair competition and tactical superiority. He employs his Fourteen Devils as force multipliers, allowing them to flank and attack while he maintains distance and throws his weaponized ball. Against single opponents, he is methodical, testing their defensive capabilities before committing to serious attacks. His greatest strength is his combination of personal physical power and summoned creature support—opponents must manage multiple simultaneous threats. His weakness is minimal when fighting fairly; his only vulnerability emerges when opponents are willing to employ tactics Razor considers 'unsporting'—strategies he may refuse to counter on principle.

Genthru.name: Genthru
Genthru.basicInfo: The Bomber, an affable blond murderer whose sunny demeanor masks a psychopath farming Greed Island players for card collections, Genthru presents a deceptively trustworthy appearance that belies his nature. He possesses a lean athletic frame with pale skin, distinctive bleached blonde hair, and regular features arranged in a perpetually friendly smile. He favors casual contemporary clothing—modern shirts and pants suggesting a harmless young man rather than a predatory killer.
personality: Sociable: presents himself as friendly and trustworthy, engaging in pleasant conversation with apparent sincerity
Ruthless: views other players as resources to exploit rather than as fellow human beings deserving consideration
Methodical: plans his operations with precision, carefully managing risk and maximizing returns from his farming activities
Emotionally detached: smiles while committing atrocities; his cheerfulness is a mask, not an indication of actual emotional content
Genthru.hiddenInfo: Genthru is the leader of a small trio of conjurer-class Nen users (himself, Sub, and Bara) who enter Greed Island with the explicit goal of farming other players for card collections. His strategy is to steal players' cards through coercion, trading, and outright murder, assembling a massive collection he then sells to achieve permanent victory in the game. His Nen category is Conjuration, and his signature technique is 'Little Flower'—an ominous conjured construct that generates a 'Countdown' timer embedded in victims' chests. When the timer reaches zero, the victim explodes. This ability makes him devastatingly dangerous; victims cannot remove the bomb without Nen exorcism, and the psychological pressure of knowing they will die in a fixed timeframe breaks most opponents quickly. His complete lack of empathy and willingness to murder makes him a genuine threat despite not being individually as powerful as some other players. His defeat at the hands of Gon (through a rock-throwing sacrifice play) represents one of the arc's most pivotal moments. ARC VALIDITY: A5 featured (Greed Island—farming operation, conflict with protagonist party); A6-A8 absent or dead.
abilities: Little Flower Conjuration: Genthru can conjure a small plant-like construct that embeds itself in a victim's chest, generating a countdown timer visible only to the victim. When the timer reaches zero, the victim explodes.
Countdown Implantation: The Little Flower can be transferred between victims through physical contact, allowing Genthru to spread the threat across multiple players simultaneously.
Conjuration Efficiency: Genthru's conjured constructs are stable and long-lasting, capable of functioning for extended periods without requiring constant concentration.
Card Valuation Expertise: Genthru understands the complete trading market for Greed Island cards and possesses knowledge of which cards are most valuable for game completion.
Psychological Manipulation: Genthru is skilled at identifying victim vulnerabilities and exploiting them through the pressure of his countdown timer.
Alliance Management: Despite his murderous nature, Genthru maintains effective working relationships with Sub and Bara, coordinating their farming operation efficiently.

fighting style: Genthru rarely engages in direct combat, instead relying on Little Flower implantation to neutralize threats. Once a countdown is active on an opponent, he maintains distance and lets psychological pressure do the work—most victims become increasingly desperate and irrational as their timer nears zero. Against opponents who resist psychological pressure or who possess exorcism capability, he becomes more aggressive, employing direct Nen techniques and physical attacks. His greatest strength is his combination of lethality and psychological devastation—opponents are fighting not just him but their own mortality. His weakness is his overconfidence and willingness to toy with victims; opponents who refuse to panic or who find unexpected solutions (like Gon's sacrifice play) can exploit his arrogance.

Sub.name: Sub
Sub.basicInfo: A lank and quiet accomplice of Genthru's Bomber trio, Sub functions as the methodical executor of farming schemes with minimal independent initiative. He possesses a gaunt frame with hollow cheeks, pale skin, and dull eyes that rarely betray emotion. He wears simple dark clothing that blends into shadows—practical wear for someone who prefers to remain unnoticed.
personality: Loyal: follows Genthru's directives without hesitation or independent questioning
Reserved: communicates sparsely; most thoughts remain internal rather than voiced
Complicit: participates willingly in atrocities without visible moral conflict
Flat affect: speaks in monotone without inflection; emotional content nearly absent from his voice
Sub.hiddenInfo: Sub is Genthru's subordinate in the Countdown farming operation and possesses a Nen category of Conjuration, enabling him to activate and manage Little Flower constructs on victims alongside Genthru. His role is to identify targets, execute diversions, and assist in card extraction from corpses. Unlike Genthru, Sub shows no enjoyment in the murders; they are tasks to be completed. His history prior to Greed Island is unknown—he appears to be a career criminal with no moral anchors. He participates fully in the trio's later farming operations and remains subordinate to Genthru throughout. ARC VALIDITY: A5 featured (Greed Island farming, subsidiary role in Bomber trio); A6-A8 absent or dead.
abilities: Countdown Conjuration: Sub can conjure and activate Little Flower constructs similar to Genthru's, embedding countdown timers in victims' chests. Functioning as a secondary bomb-maker for the operation.
Conjuration Stability: Sub's conjured constructs maintain integrity over extended periods, requiring minimal concentration and allowing him to manage multiple active bombs simultaneously.
Efficient Execution: Sub executes assigned tasks with mechanical precision, locating victims and restraining them during Little Flower implantation.
Card Retrieval Expertise: Sub possesses knowledge of valuable Greed Island cards and can quickly assess victim collections for profitable extraction.
Silent Movement: Sub moves quietly and efficiently, blending into background environments to avoid detection or confrontation.
Operational Coordination: Sub maintains communication with Genthru and Bara, executing complex farming raids that require synchronized timing.

fighting style: Sub engages in combat reluctantly, preferring to distance himself through Nen-based restraint rather than direct confrontation. When forced to fight, he employs conjured constructs defensively, creating barriers or containment zones. He focuses on disabling opponents through psychological pressure (the countdown timer) rather than sustained physical violence. Against aggressive opponents, Sub becomes evasive, relying on movement and terrain advantage rather than power. His greatest weakness is his lack of combat initiative and independent decision-making—without Genthru's direction, he struggles to adapt to unexpected situations.

Bara.name: Bara
Bara.basicInfo: The broad-shouldered and watchful third member of Genthru's Bomber trio, Bara serves as lookout and tactical coordinator for the group's predatory operations. He possesses a muscular, compact frame with dark skin, alert eyes that constantly scan his surroundings, and short dark hair kept practical for action. He wears functional clothing suited for mobility—loose shirts and reinforced pants allowing rapid movement.
personality: Vigilant: maintains constant awareness of surroundings and potential threats; rarely caught unaware
Cautious: prefers to assess situations before committing to action, avoiding unnecessary risk
Obedient: defers to Genthru's leadership and accepts his role within the trio's hierarchy without resentment
Direct speech: communicates clearly and efficiently; prefers practical information over unnecessary elaboration
Bara.hiddenInfo: Bara functions as the lookout and tactical coordinator for Genthru's Countdown farming operation, managing surveillance, identifying victim targets, and monitoring for external threats to the trio's activities. Like Sub, he is a Conjurer capable of activating Little Flower constructs. Bara's distinguishing trait is his heightened tactical awareness—he coordinates ambush positions, manages escape routes, and handles contingency planning when operations encounter interference. His pre-Greed Island background is unknown, suggesting a mercenary or criminal background. He demonstrates no moral conflict with the murders and executions conducted by the trio, accepting them as operational necessity. He remains loyal to Genthru throughout the arc and dies alongside Sub during the confrontation with the protagonist party. ARC VALIDITY: A5 featured (Greed Island farming, tactical coordination role); dies end of A5; A6-A8 absent.
abilities: Countdown Conjuration: Bara can conjure and activate Little Flower constructs, serving as a third bomb-maker for the operation and multiplying the trio's capacity to manage simultaneous victims.
Conjuration Precision: Bara's conjured constructs are particularly stable and reliable, rarely malfunctioning and maintaining full function across extended operational timeframes.
Tactical Assessment: Bara evaluates locations, victim positioning, and escape routes with strategic precision, identifying optimal engagement positions for ambush operations.
Environmental Awareness: Bara maintains heightened sensory perception of his surroundings, detecting approaching threats and monitoring multiple areas simultaneously.
Defensive Positioning: Bara excels at selecting advantageous terrain and creating defensive perimeters around the trio's operations.
Coordinated Suppression: Bara synchronizes attacks with Genthru and Sub, ensuring multiple opponents cannot coordinate effective counteroffensives.

fighting style: Bara approaches combat defensively, preferring to establish secure positions and deny enemy movement through environmental control. He uses Nen constructs to create barriers, channels, and kill zones that funnel opponents into disadvantageous positions. When engaging directly, he favors overwhelming physical strength combined with tactical positioning—forcing opponents into confined spaces where his broader frame provides advantage. Against multiple opponents, he separates them through positioning, preventing coordinated attacks. His greatest strength is tactical awareness and positioning; his weakness is his reliance on Genthru's strategic direction for complex situations beyond established tactics.

Tsezguerra.name: Tsezguerra
Tsezguerra.basicInfo: A dour and battle-scarred veteran hired as Battera's chief contracted professional to orchestrate the clear campaign, Tsezguerra carries the weight of countless conflicts and hard choices across his weathered frame. He possesses a muscular, imposing build marked by visible scars, dark skin weathered by exposure, stern angular features, and iron-gray hair kept in military-style order. He favors practical combat attire—reinforced jackets, tactical gear, and weapons suggesting a life spent in conflict.
personality: Pragmatic: makes decisions based on practical outcomes rather than idealism; willing to sacrifice individuals for group objectives
Professional: treats his contracted work with serious discipline and expects equivalent commitment from team members
Hardened: years of combat have dulled emotional responses; he addresses suffering and death as operational realities
Commanding: speaks with authority born from years of leadership; expects his orders to be executed without question
Tsezguerra.hiddenInfo: Tsezguerra is a veteran professional Nen user contracted by the billionaire Battera as chief strategist and commander of the Clear Campaign—an elite team assembled to complete the Greed Island game within a specific timeframe. He is experienced in managing teams of mixed Nen-user types and excels at tactical coordination in high-stakes environments. His Nen category is Emission, allowing him to deploy aura-based attacks at range. He maintains discipline within his team and prioritizes the mission objective over individual survival, making difficult decisions about resource allocation and member assignment. He views Tsezguerra operates with complete professionalism and shows genuine respect for capable team members, particularly Goreinu. His ultimate goal is completing Battera's contract and earning substantial compensation. Unlike Genthru, Tsezguerra has no interest in personal power accumulation; the contract is the entirety of his concern. ARC VALIDITY: A5 featured (Greed Island Clear Campaign commander, tactical coordination); A6-A8 unknown status (likely surviving post-game).
abilities: Emission Aura Projection: Tsezguerra projects aura-based attacks at range, creating energy blasts and sustained pressure that can be deployed across distances beyond hand-to-hand range.
Strategic Command: Tsezguerra possesses deep experience coordinating multiple team members with different Nen categories, creating synergistic attack combinations and defensive formations.
Tactical Assessment: Tsezguerra evaluates enemies and environments with military precision, identifying weaknesses and optimal engagement strategies within moments.
Resilience and Endurance: Years of conflict have conditioned Tsezguerra to function effectively despite injury, fatigue, and emotional pressure that would incapacitate less experienced combatants.
Authority and Discipline: Tsezguerra's commands carry natural weight; team members follow his directives instinctively, enabling rapid tactical coordination.
Veteran Combat Experience: Tsezguerra has fought across multiple continents and against diverse opponent types, giving him adaptive tactics for nearly any combat scenario.

fighting style: Tsezguerra fights with calculated efficiency, employing ranged Emission attacks to maintain distance while assessing opponent capabilities. He prefers structured engagement—testing opponent defenses, identifying vulnerabilities, then committing to a decisive assault. When commanding a team, he positions himself as a central coordinator, assigning roles and adjusting strategy in real-time as circumstances evolve. Against superior individual fighters, he gravitates toward team synergy rather than attempting direct victory. His greatest strength is his experience and ability to remain effective under pressure; his weakness is his reliance on team structure—isolated from support, he becomes reactive rather than proactive.

Goreinu.name: Goreinu
Goreinu.basicInfo: A quiet and methodical strategist in Tsezguerra's Clear Campaign, Goreinu possesses an unassuming presence that masks a brilliant tactical mind and one of Nen's most unusual conjurations. He is lean and inconspicuous in build with unremarkable features, neutral expression, and practical clothing that allows him to fade into group settings. Most notable are the two distinct conjured gorillas constantly manifested beside him—one white and one black.
personality: Analytical: processes complex information and identifies patterns others miss; strategic thinking flows naturally
Quiet: speaks rarely; most of his thoughts remain unvoiced unless directly solicited by teammates
Adaptable: adjusts tactical approach based on opponent capabilities; prefers flexible systems to rigid strategies
Cooperative: genuinely values collaborative effort and respects other team members' contributions and expertise
Goreinu.hiddenInfo: Goreinu is a Nen Professional of the Emitter category whose signature Hatsu is an extraordinary conjuration: two sentient gorillas (one white, one black) permanently manifested beside him. These gorillas possess independent agency and combative capability; they also possess a unique cooperative ability—the White gorilla can swap positions with Goreinu, while the Black gorilla can swap positions with a target opponent, creating chaotic repositioning opportunities during combat. This ability makes him invaluable for team tactics as he can relocate himself, allies, or enemies as tactical situations demand. Goreinu serves as a strategic coordinator under Tsezguerra and is respected for both his combat capability and his calm demeanor under pressure. Unlike many professional Nen users, Goreinu demonstrates genuine kindness toward teammates and shows no interest in betrayal or exploitation. His partnership with his conjured gorillas appears deeply genuine—he treats them as partners rather than tools. He displays particular respect for Tsezguerra's leadership. ARC VALIDITY: A5 featured (Greed Island Clear Campaign, strategic coordination); A6-A8 unknown status (likely surviving post-game).
abilities: Conjured Gorilla Manifestation: Goreinu permanently manifests two conjured gorillas (white and black) possessing independent movement, durability, and offensive capability. These constructs persist for extended periods and can engage opponents simultaneously.

Position Swap—White Gorilla: The white gorilla can exchange positions with Goreinu, allowing him to instantly relocate himself during combat for escape, repositioning, or unexpected tactical advantage.
Position Swap—Black Gorilla: The black gorilla can exchange positions with a targeted opponent, disrupting enemy formation and creating openings for team coordination.
Gorilla Endurance: The conjured gorillas demonstrate exceptional durability and can absorb damage that would incapacitate ordinary Nen constructs, maintaining function across extended engagements.
Tactical Coordination: Goreinu possesses deep strategic knowledge of team synergy and excels at identifying how different Nen categories can be combined for maximum effectiveness.
Calm Under Pressure: Goreinu maintains analytical clarity even during high-stress combat, enabling him to identify tactical opportunities when other team members become emotional.

fighting style: Goreinu fights as a coordinator rather than a primary combatant, positioning his gorillas to control space while maintaining strategic oversight. His own role is to identify tactical opportunities and direct team positioning through gorilla swaps. His gorillas engage opponents directly while he provides ranged support or coordinates team attacks. Against opponents who isolate him from his gorillas, he becomes vulnerable—his conjurations are his true combat strength, not his personal physical capability. His greatest strength is his flexibility and ability to adapt tactics mid-combat; his weakness is his reliance on his gorillas for direct combat effectiveness.

Abengane.name: Abengane
Abengane.basicInfo: A specialist Nen exorcist of quiet demeanor and mysterious background, Abengane commands knowledge of parasite-removal rituals known to few Nen practitioners. He is of indeterminate age with weathered features, dark skin, and a calm expression suggesting deep spiritual practice. He favors simple robes and carries ritual implements—suggesting a practitioner of esoteric arts rather than a combat specialist.
personality: Contemplative: observes situations deeply before responding; decision-making follows internal reflection
Knowledgeable: possesses expertise in obscure Nen techniques inaccessible to most practitioners
Cautious: exercises restraint when engaging with unknown Nen phenomena; prioritizes safety over speed
Matter-of-fact: delivers information without embellishment; speaks in practical, direct language
Abengane.hiddenInfo: Abengane is a specialist Nen exorcist who practices an unusual discipline: the removal of parasitic Nen constructs embedded within hosts. His signature technique involves the conjuration of a parasitic-eating Nen beast summoned through elaborate ritual ceremonies that can effectively neutralize and extract deeply-embedded Nen parasites from victims' bodies. His Nen category is Conjuration, focused on esoteric ritual magic rather than direct combat. Abengane's primary income derives from contract work removing Nen parasites from desperate clients; he maintains a relatively low profile in the professional Nen community. In the Greed Island arc, his involvement is minimal, though he participates in the game environment. However, his true significance emerges post-Arc 5: Hisoka contracts Abengane's services to remove Chrollo's Judgment Chain—a vow-based sealing that locks Chrollo's Nen entirely. Abengane successfully performs the exorcism ritual, restoring Chrollo's Nen access and triggering a cascade of events leading to Hisoka's eventual confrontation with the Phantom Troupe. His knowledge makes him valuable to anyone seeking Nen manipulation or curse removal. ARC VALIDITY: A5 participant (minimal involvement); A7 featured (post-arc—exorcises Chrollo's curse); important to A8 (Troupe/Hisoka conflict aboard the Black Whale).
abilities: Nen Exorcism Ritual: Abengane can conduct elaborate ceremonies to detect, diagnose, and remove parasitic Nen constructs embedded within victims' bodies. This process requires time and preparation but proves effective against even powerful vow-based sealing.
Parasite-Eating Beast Conjuration: Abengane conjures a specialized Nen beast designed to consume and neutralize parasitic Nen constructs, systematically removing curse effects from hosts.
Nen Diagnosis: Abengane can detect and analyze the structure of embedded Nen parasites, determining their origin, function, and removal difficulty with expert precision.
Ritual Magic Knowledge: Abengane possesses deep knowledge of esoteric Nen rituals, enabling him to conduct ceremonies most Nen practitioners consider impossible or impractical.
Spiritual Fortitude: Abengane maintains mental and spiritual clarity during lengthy rituals, resisting psychic pressure or hostile Nen from embedded parasites attempting to defend themselves.
Defensive Conjuration: Abengane can create protective barriers and containing fields using Nen to prevent escaped parasites from harming assistants or spreading infection.

fighting style: Abengane rarely engages in direct combat, instead using Nen defensively to maintain protective barriers during exorcism work. When forced to fight, he employs his conjured parasitic-eating beast as a direct combatant while maintaining distance and ritual focus. His strength lies in specialized knowledge and preparatory rituals rather than reflexive combat response. Against opponents who interrupt his rituals or contaminate his workspace, he becomes less effective—his power derives from preparation and sustained concentration rather than improvisation. His greatest strength is his unique expertise; his weakness is his reliance on time and preparation for effectiveness.

List.name: List
List.basicInfo: A calm and methodical administrator overseeing Greed Island's game management, List demonstrates the precision and organizational focus required to coordinate one of the world's most complex Nen constructs. He is of lean build with sharp features, neutral expression, and precise movements suggesting professional training. He favors formal administrative attire—clean shirts, slacks, and practical footwear suitable for extended facility patrol.
personality: Disciplined: maintains absolute adherence to protocols and established rules; deviations are treated as serious breaches
Analytical: approaches problems systematically; decisions derive from data analysis rather than intuition
Impartial: enforces rules uniformly regardless of player status or political position; fairness is his core principle
Formal: communicates in structured, professional language; maintains emotional distance from players and colleagues
List.hiddenInfo: List is one of Ging Freecss's chosen game masters for Greed Island and serves primarily as a rule administrator and facility coordinator. His role involves managing game-play protocols, arbitrating disputes regarding card validity and trading, monitoring player progress toward game completion, and enforcing consequences for rule violations. Unlike the more visible game masters (Razor), List maintains a lower profile, preferring administrative work to direct confrontation. His Nen category is Manipulation, allowing him to oversee complex magical systems and enforce game-level Nen restrictions on all players. He possesses no particular combat specialty and deliberately avoids direct conflict, leaving such matters to more combat-focused administrators. List is professional, unfailingly fair, and carries no personal agenda regarding player success or failure. He views Greed Island as an experimental construct worthy of protection and proper management. ARC VALIDITY: A5 featured (game master administrator, rules enforcement, facility oversight); A6-A8 status unknown (likely continuing post-game management).
abilities: Game Administration Expertise: List possesses comprehensive knowledge of Greed Island's rules, card systems, and completion pathways, enabling him to arbitrate disputes and verify compliance.
Nen Restriction Enforcement: List can monitor and enforce Nen-level restrictions placed on all players within Greed Island, preventing over-powered techniques and maintaining game balance.
Facility Oversight: List manages Greed Island's physical infrastructure, monitoring locations, identifying environmental hazards, and coordinating facility maintenance.
Protocol Enforcement: List maintains detailed records of rule violations, trading disputes, and player conduct, enabling him to apply consistent consequences across the player population.
Dispute Arbitration: List adjudicates complex trading disagreements and card-validity questions with absolute impartiality, earning respect from both sides of disputed transactions.
Documentation Mastery: List maintains meticulous records of all players, completed cards, and game progress, enabling comprehensive oversight of the entire game environment.

fighting style: List avoids direct combat whenever possible, relying on facility control and Nen restrictions to neutralize threats. If forced into conflict, he uses Manipulation-based Nen to constrain opponents' movement or divert hostile intent. His strength lies in systematic knowledge and administrative authority rather than combat capability. Against opponents willing to disregard rules and facility protocols, he becomes significantly less effective. His greatest strength is his organizational mastery and impartiality; his weakness is his lack of combat experience and reliance on environmental advantage.

Dwun.name: Dwun
Dwun.basicInfo: An eccentric inventor and game-master engineer who designed much of Greed Island's card-based mechanisms, Dwun combines brilliant technical creativity with unpredictable personality quirks. He possesses an average build with tousled hair suggesting constant distraction, bright inquisitive eyes, and clothing adorned with various technical tools and partial contraptions. He moves with jerky, efficient motions and frequently fidgets with mysterious devices.
personality: Creative: generates innovative solutions and unexpected technological approaches to engineering challenges
Eccentric: demonstrates unusual behavioral patterns and unconventional approaches to social interaction
Obsessive: focuses intensely on projects of interest to the exclusion of other concerns or social obligations
Volatile: emotional responses can shift rapidly based on perceived slights to his technical work or interrupted focus
Dwun.hiddenInfo: Dwun is a brilliant Nen-based engineer and designer contracted by Ging Freecss to create Greed Island's card mechanics and spell-system infrastructure. His Nen category is Specialization, enabling him to manipulate complex magical systems and create the elaborate mechanisms by which cards function within the game world. Dwun designed the card-binding system, spell-execution protocols, and much of the game's internal technical architecture. He is creative, brilliant, and thoroughly unpredictable—his emotional attachments to his creations can lead to strong reactions if players exploit or damage his designs. Unlike other game masters who engage directly with players, Dwun prefers to work behind scenes, troubleshooting technical problems and implementing new systems. He is capable of combat Nen use but treats fighting as an interruption to his true work. He maintains cordial relationships with other game masters but can become irritable if his technical decisions are questioned. ARC VALIDITY: A5 featured (game master engineer, technical oversight, facility design); A6-A8 status unknown (likely continuing post-game management).
abilities: Card System Design: Dwun created Greed Island's entire card-binding and spell-execution system; he maintains intimate knowledge of its mechanisms and can diagnose any technical malfunction.
Spell Architecture Mastery: Dwun designed the spells available within Greed Island and can modify, disable, or enhance them as needed through his Specialization Nen.
Technical Innovation: Dwun rapidly generates creative solutions to mechanical problems, designing new systems and repair protocols under time pressure.
Nen-Based Construction: Dwun can manifest temporary structures, diagnostic tools, and mechanical devices using Nen, enabling him to work without external materials.
System Troubleshooting: Dwun can rapidly identify and resolve technical malfunctions within Greed Island's magical infrastructure, maintaining game stability.
Temporal Nen Manipulation: Dwun's Specialization enables him to interact with the boundary between normal Nen and the constructed reality of Greed Island, allowing unique interventions.

fighting style: Dwun engages in combat reluctantly and typically only when his work is threatened. He employs Nen-based constructs defensively—building walls, barriers, or temporary obstacles to create distance. If forced into sustained combat, he becomes increasingly frustrated and erratic, making tactical errors as his focus fragments between fighting and protecting his technical work. Against opponent who target his creations, he fights with uncharacteristic aggression. His greatest strength is his unique technical knowledge and ability to manipulate the game environment; his weakness is his lack of combat training and emotional volatility when distracted.

Eta.name: Eta
Eta.basicInfo: The game's charismatic mistress of ceremonies, Eta serves as the public face and presenter of Greed Island's most prestigious rewards and tournament moments. She possesses an athletic build with rich dark skin, striking features, dark hair typically styled elegantly, and expressive eyes that command attention. She favors elaborate formal wear suited to ceremonial occasions—tailored dresses and ornate jewelry suggesting her high-status role.
personality: Charismatic: commands attention and respect through natural magnetism and compelling speech
Theatrical: approaches all interactions with dramatic flair; entertainment value is paramount
Equitable: treats all players with equal respect regardless of status; fairness is genuine principle
Professional: maintains emotional distance while creating appearance of personal connection with audience
Eta.hiddenInfo: Eta is a game master contracted by Ging Freecss to serve as Greed Island's primary ceremonial coordinator and public-facing representative. Her role involves announcing tournament brackets, presenting rewards, facilitating major game events, and serving as the primary point of contact for player inquiries regarding high-level game mechanics. Her Nen category is Enhancement, enabling her to project her voice across massive spaces and maintain physical presence befitting formal occasions.
