Satotz is a Nen Practitioner and an Enhancer with a developing signature technique focused on Enhancement. He is methodical, professional, and utterly devoted to the Association's standards. Satotz proctors the physical trials of the Hunter Exam with precision—he leads applicants through dangerous terrain, tests their resolve, and eliminates those who cannot keep pace. His Hatsu emphasizes amplification and aura control; he is still refining its form and application, pushing its boundaries through constant practice. Unlike the more colorful examiners (Menchi and Buhara), Satotz is quiet and observant, noting character flaws and hidden potential with equal thoroughness. He appears across multiple arcs as a Hunter Association staff member, always professional, always watching.

premadeCharacters.name: Menchi
premadeCharacters.description: A food-expert examiner whose passion for cuisine borders on obsession. Menchi is a licensed hunter and Nen Practitioner with a Transmuter's category. She developed a Hatsu focused on Transmutation—likely related to her expertise in cooking and food preparation, though the specifics are known only to her. She administers the cooking trial of the Hunter Exam, a test that seems deceptively simple until applicants realize they are being judged not on technical skill but on their willingness to adapt, improvise, and feed others. Menchi is cheerful, energetic, and surprisingly kind, though her standards are exacting. She treats food preparation as a spiritual practice—not merely about sustenance but about understanding ingredients, respecting sources, and nourishing those who consume what you create. Her Nen mastery serves these values; she channels her Nen into creating better food, stronger meals, and more meaningful cuisine.

premadeCharacters.name: Buhara
premadeCharacters.description: A massive examiner whose enormous frame belies a thoughtful nature. Buhara is a licensed hunter and Nen Practitioner with an Enhancer's category and a developing signature technique. He is passionate about food in his own way—his massive appetite is legendary, and his trial of the Hunter Exam involves hunting and retrieving rare beasts and fish from dangerous waters. Buhara views hunting as a fundamental test of survival instinct; he believes that any hunter worth the license must be capable of finding, catching, and securing food in the field. His Hatsu focuses on Enhancement—amplifying his already prodigious strength and durability to superhuman levels, allowing him to dive deeper, swim faster, and haul larger catches than any ordinary person could manage. Buhara is kind and fair, though his trials are genuinely dangerous. He takes pride in identifying hunters who understand that the Hunter license is not a prize but a responsibility.

premadeCharacters.name: Lippo
premadeCharacters.description: A Hunter Association staff member and examiner who oversees administrative and logistical aspects of the Hunter Exam. Lippo is a Nen Practitioner with a Manipulator's category and a developing Hatsu focused on Manipulation. He likely channels his Nen into organizing, controlling, and managing the complex mechanisms of the exam itself—controlling the movements of participants, managing the logistics of trials, and using his Nen to influence external systems. Lippo is professional and bureaucratic, embodying the Hunter Association's organizational machine. He is less flamboyant than other examiners but equally capable in his domain. His Hatsu remains a work in progress, refined through years of administrative application and the constant small challenges of managing hundreds of applicants across multiple trials.

premadeCharacters.name: Hanzo
premadeCharacters.description: A shinobi from the hidden nation of Jappon and an applicant at the Hunter Exam. Hanzo is lean, disciplined, and utterly lethal despite his youth. He is trained in ninjutsu—the stealth arts of assassination and reconnaissance—and his Nen category is Conjuration. His developing Hatsu focuses on Conjuration, likely manifesting through ninja-inspired techniques involving summoning weapons, creating barriers, or conjuring tools of stealth and combat. Hanzo fights with precision and honor; he refuses to kill an unresisting opponent during the exam tournament, choosing instead to demonstrate his superiority and force a concession. This choice costs him advancement but reveals his moral code: he values proving his skill over mere victory. Hanzo becomes a beloved figure to players partly because he is genuinely honorable in a world that often rewards ruthlessness. His Nen mastery is solid, his ninja training unmatched, and his character arc is one of growth through principle rather than power.

premadeCharacters.name: Pokkle
premadeCharacters.description: A young Hunter Exam applicant with genuine talent and genuine heart. Pokkle is a Nen Initiate—newly awakened to Nen's possibilities—with an Emitter's category. His developing Hatsu focuses on Emission, though his technique remains nascent and unrefined. He is earnest, kind, and perhaps too trusting for a world that demands ruthlessness. Pokkle forms bonds with others at the exam, competing not out of ambition but out of desire to test himself and grow stronger. He survives the exam and goes on to become a licensed hunter, but the Chimera Ant arc is cruel to him. As the world descends into chaos during the ant invasion, Pokkle is captured and becomes food for the ants—a grim fate that underscores the series' willingness to punish good intentions. This premade offers a player the chance to experience a good-hearted hunter at the exam's beginning, before the world's darkness claims him.

premadeCharacters.name: Ponzu
premadeCharacters.description: A young woman applicant at the Hunter Exam who is cheerful, resourceful, and deceptively capable. Ponzu is a Nen Initiate with a Manipulator's category and a developing Hatsu focused on Manipulation. She uses her Nen to command insects—particularly a swarm of venomous wasps—turning them into extensions of her will. This technique is creative and pragmatic; she uses her insects for reconnaissance, defense, and offense, demonstrating a playful flexibility in combat. Ponzu is friendly and open, often serving as a social bridge between exam applicants who might otherwise remain isolated. She survives the exam and becomes licensed, but like Pokkle, she faces a tragic end in the Chimera Ant arc. Her death—along with Pokkle's—emphasizes that this world is dangerous, that good people can die meaninglessly, and that the Hunter Association's approval is no guarantee of survival. She represents the optimism of youth in a series that refuses to protect the innocent.

premadeCharacters.name: Tonpa
premadeCharacters.description: The 36-time Hunter Exam veteran and the world's most persistent failure. Tonpa applies to the exam year after year, hoping to pass but never succeeding. He is Nen-Unawakened, a fact that should disqualify him from ever passing a Nen-heavy exam—yet he keeps trying. Tonpa's only apparent skill is sabotage: he poisons other applicants, spreads rumors, and uses psychological manipulation to undermine his competition. He is deceitful, cowardly, and genuinely unlikeable. Yet playing as Tonpa offers something unique: the chance to experience the Hunter Exam as a deliberately weak character with no special powers, minimal training, and only cunning and ruthlessness to lean on. This premade challenges players to succeed through intelligence and adaptation rather than power, to succeed *despite* weakness. It is a deliberately difficult run, a joke character who becomes profound through the lens of desperation. Tonpa wants power; he doesn't have it. So he breaks others to get ahead. Whether that path leads to anything but misery is left to the player.

premadeCharacters.name: Wing
premadeCharacters.description: A teacher and genuine mentor of the Heavens Arena, Wing is a Nen Adept with an Enhancer's category and a developing Hatsu focused on Enhancement. He is honest, patient, and deeply committed to teaching the next generation of Nen users. Unlike many Heavens Arena regulars, Wing does not use the arena to test himself against challengers or to dominate opponents for pride. Instead, he views it as a classroom where he can train younger hunters in the foundational techniques of Nen. He teaches Water Divination honestly, revealing the truth behind Ten, Ren, and Hatsu without hiding dangerous details or limiting knowledge. Wing's Nen mastery is solid and refined; his Hatsu remains in development because his primary focus is on teaching others rather than on advancing his own technique. He becomes a father figure to Gon and Killua, demonstrating what genuine mentorship looks like in a world often lacking it. His character arc emphasizes that strength is not merely about power but about wisdom, patience, and the willingness to lift others up.

premadeCharacters.name: Zushi
premadeCharacters.description: A young arena fighter and an apprentice of Wing, Zushi is a Nen Initiate with an Enhancer's category. He is earnest, hardworking, and eager to improve his Nen mastery. Zushi has not yet awakened his Hatsu—his focus is on solidifying his foundational techniques and learning the control that separates amateurs from professionals. He trains constantly under Wing's guidance, pushing himself through rigorous practice. Zushi's greatest weakness is his lack of experience; his greatest strength is his teachability and his discipline. He becomes a sparring partner for Gon and Killua at the arena, offering the chance to fight someone at a similar level—peers rather than overwhelming masters or helpless novices. Zushi represents the journey of growth for younger hunters, the grinding work of improvement that happens away from dramatic battle sequences. Playing as Zushi means starting weak but with the genuine potential to improve, supported by a mentor who cares.

premadeCharacters.name: Kastro
premadeCharacters.description: A formidable arena fighter and a Nen Adept with an Enhancer's category. Kastro developed Tiger Bite Double, a Hatsu technique that creates an autonomous aura duplicate of his body, granting him the ability to fight as two simultaneous opponents. His signature move is Tiger Bite Fist—a devastating enhanced strike that combines his physical strength with aura amplification. Kastro is proud, competitive, and genuinely talented. However, his pride becomes his downfall: he attempts his Double technique against Hisoka, unaware that Hisoka's Transmutation and analytical mind can counter aura duplicates. The duel becomes tragic—Kastro's memory coordination between original and duplicate fails under pressure, disorienting him. He is defeated and humiliated by Hisoka, a defeat that defines his character arc. Kastro made a vow to himself—Vow: Announce the Kill—binding his pride to his combat style. Playing as Kastro offers the chance to experience a genuinely skilled fighter whose confidence becomes his curse, whose technique is real but whose limitations are fatal.

premadeCharacters.name: Chrollo Lucilfer
premadeCharacters.description: The leader of the Phantom Troupe, a man of rare intellect and surgical precision. Chrollo is handsome in an unsettling way—dark hair, sharp eyes, a voice that commands absolute attention. He was born in Meteor City, a scavenger metropolis inhabited by the stateless and forgotten, and rose from that ash to become the head of the Spider—a thief collective of thirteen members, each marked with a spider tattoo and a number. Chrollo's Nen category is Specialist, a classification held by fewer than one in ten thousand users. His signature Hatsu, Skill Hunter, allows him to absorb the abilities of other Nen users through a conjured book, stealing their techniques permanently and making them his own. He is a master strategist, caring for the Spider's survival above all else—every member is a limb of the Spider, and the head will protect every limb or rebuild the body. Chrollo speaks with intellectual passion about theft as philosophy. A crucial note for play: in the Yorknew arc and beyond until the Election, Chrollo's Nen is sealed by Kurapika's Judgment Chain—he cannot use Nen and cannot contact his members. This premade best suits pre-Yorknew encounters or post-Election play when his seal is broken and his power restored.

premadeCharacters.name: Nobunaga Hazama
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#1) and a swordmaster steeped in martial heritage. Nobunaga is lean and dangerous, with an expressionless face and a warrior's bearing. His historical name suggests samurai lineage; he carries himself with the discipline of a traditional iaido practitioner. Nobunaga's Nen category is Enhancement, and his signature Hatsu, Battōjutsu En, fuses the traditional Japanese sword draw with aura amplification. His strikes are impossibly fast, his blade-work flawless. When Nobunaga draws, he moves with practiced speed that borders on invisible. He is a member of the Spider not out of loyalty to Chrollo's philosophy but out of respect—Nobunaga serves the collective because he believes in the strength of the Troupe as a unified body. He speaks little, acts with decisive force, and will sacrifice anything for the Spider's survival. His era note: canonical through all arcs, alive and operational.

premadeCharacters.name: Feitan Portor
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#2) and the resident master of agony. Feitan is small and childlike in frame, with pale skin and an accent that marks him as an outsider to most cultures. His appearance is deceptive—beneath that slight frame lies a torturer of surgical precision and a Nen user of terrifying power. Feitan's Nen category is Transmutation, and his signature technique, Pain Packer, manifests in his Rising Sun form—a state of absolute rage where his aura transforms into a sphere of destructive heat that will consume everything in its radius. He channels suffering itself, turning trauma into technique. Feitan is quiet, detached, and treats torture as both craft and philosophy. He binds himself with a Vow: Stake of Lifeblood—a binding that deepens his power but ties him to a personal principle of absolute commitment. He is dangerous in ways that go beyond simple strength; he is the Troupe's instrument of pain, and he has refined it into an art. Canon validity: alive and operational through all published arcs.

premadeCharacters.name: Machi Komacine
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#3) and one of the few women in the Spider's ranks. Machi is calm, practical, and utterly without sentimentality. She is an Nen Adept with a Transmuter's category, and her signature Hatsu, Nen Stitches, allows her to conjure thin threads of aura that can bind wounds, repair damage, or serve as tools of restraint and binding. Her threads are extraordinarily fine and nearly invisible—a mark of a master Transmuter's control. She carries the Spider's supplies and serves as a healer when needed, though her threads serve equally well in combat, wrapping opponents or cutting through flesh with surgical precision. Machi is fiercely loyal to the Spider as an organization; she will protect its unity above personal bonds. She is sometimes the voice of reason when Troupe members clash, but she never questions the head's decisions. Machi's bearing is quiet, observant, and dangerous. She speaks rarely but is always listening.

premadeCharacters.name: Phinks Magcub
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#5) and a machine of raw Enhancement. Phinks is muscular, aggressive, and impulsive—he wears his violence openly. His Nen category is Enhancement, and his signature Hatsu, Ripper Cyclotron, allows him to spin his entire body at terrifying speed while channeling aura, creating a rotating blade of pure force. When activated, Phinks becomes a human cyclone, shredding anything in his path. The more he winds up, the stronger the effect; but he loses fine control, making it a technique of pure devastation rather than precision. Phinks is straightforward in his thinking—problems are solved with force; hesitation is weakness. He is not stupid, but he is direct to the point of simplicity. He respects the Spider's hierarchy and Chrollo's leadership, but his loyalty is pragmatic; he stays because the Troupe is strong and because his fellow members are the closest thing to a family he has known. Phinks is the kind of fighter who wins through overwhelming aggression and the refusal to back down.

premadeCharacters.name: Franklin Bordeau
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#7) and an unstoppable ranged combatant. Franklin is large, dark-skinned, with dreadlocks and a laid-back demeanor that masks absolute lethality. His Nen category is Emission, and his signature Hatsu, Double Machine Gun, transforms his aura into projectile weapons—bullets of pure force that fire from his fingertips in rapid, devastating volleys. He literally shoots his aura as ammunition, firing continuously with destructive precision. Franklin has an unusual vow binding him: Vow: Stake of Lifeblood, in which he bound his own severed fingertips to the power, deepening the technique at a permanent cost. His hands are marked by this sacrifice; he is missing fingertips, a visible reminder of his commitment. Franklin is relaxed, philosophical, and genuinely kind to his Troupe members—he is the closest thing the Spider has to a genuine voice of compassion, though his compassion does not extend to outsiders. He is a family man, dedicated to the Spider's collective survival.

premadeCharacters.name: Shalnark
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#6) and a communications specialist with a predatory intelligence. Shalnark is boyish and cheerful in appearance, with a constant smile and an air of casual friendliness that masks lethal cunning. His Nen category is Manipulation, and his signature Hatsu, Black Voice, allows him to implant a needle in a victim's head, granting him complete control over their body and mind. Once activated, the victim becomes an extension of Shalnark's will—a puppet. Black Voice is one of the most insidious Nen techniques in existence, turning sentient beings into mere tools. Shalnark is brilliant with technology and communications, serving the Spider as both tactician and coordinator. He is charming and personable, making it easy to forget his fundamental amorality. He is not sadistic; he simply does not view others as people in the same way he views himself. Shalnark belongs entirely to the Troupe; the Spider's survival is his only directive. Era note: canon through most arcs, but dies in the Dark Continent expedition (A8) when Hisoka murders him as part of the war on the Troupe.

premadeCharacters.name: Shizuku Murasaki
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#8) and a specialist in asset acquisition and erasure. Shizuku is young, quiet, and has a vacant, dreamy quality to her demeanor—she often speaks slowly and seems half-asleep. This façade conceals a sharp mind and a Nen ability that is horrifyingly effective. She is a Nen Adept with a Conjurer's category, and her signature Hatsu, Blinky, manifests as a sentient vacuum cleaner—a conjured creature that absorbs anything Shizuku commands into its internal void. Blinky is living, obedient, and nearly indestructible; it can consume entire buildings, people, or objets d'art and store them in its internal pocket dimension. Shizuku often wanders off to find and collect interesting items, her vacuum trailing behind her. She is the Troupe's acquisitions expert, but she is also genuinely eccentric—her interests are idiosyncratic and often puzzling to her comrades. She is loyal to the Troupe but in a distant, detached way. She does not hate her victims; she simply does not think of them as mattering.

premadeCharacters.name: Pakunoda
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#9) and a keeper of secrets through force. Pakunoda is beautiful and sharp, with an air of controlled intensity. Her Nen category is Specialist, a rarity that marks her as possessing a unique gift. Her signature Hatsu, Memory Bomb, allows her to read the memories of others through touch and share those memories with other people. By touching an opponent or ally, she can extract their memories or implant memories from others into their minds. This makes her invaluable for reconnaissance, interrogation, and information warfare. Memory Bomb has a fatal limitation—each use consumes a portion of her remaining lifespan. Pakunoda is aware of this cost and accepts it as the price of her power. She is serious, loyal to the Troupe above all else, and willing to sacrifice herself to protect her comrades. Her arc validity note: A1-A4; she dies at the end of the Yorknew arc, spending her remaining life in a final activation of Memory Bomb to save Troupe members from a memory erasure. Her death is one of sacrifice.

premadeCharacters.name: Uvogin
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#11) and the embodiment of overwhelming physical power. Uvogin is massive, muscular, and carries himself with the casual confidence of someone who has never met an opponent he could not overpower. His Nen category is Enhancement, and his signature Hatsu, Big Bang Impact, channels all of his aura into a single concentrated punch—a strike that detonates with the force of an explosion, leveling everything in its path. When Uvogin activates Big Bang Impact at full power, he becomes an unstoppable force of destruction. Uvogin is not subtle; he is not strategic. He is direct, aggressive, and honestly believes that strength solves all problems. He is loud, confident, and genuinely good-natured with his Troupe members despite his terrifying power. He has made a Vow: Death Before Retreat—a binding that prevents him from fleeing or surrendering, no matter the circumstances. This vow costs him his life in the Yorknew arc when he is captured and interrogated by Kurapika. Arc validity: A1-A4; dies end of Yorknew City arc through Kurapika's Judgment Chain.

premadeCharacters.name: Bonolenov Ndongo
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#10) and an artist of violence. Bonolenov is tall and dark-skinned, with a musical quality to his speech and a theatrical bearing. He is a Nen Adept with a Conjurer's category, and his signature Hatsu, Battle Cantabile, allows him to conjure a sophisticated aura construct—a musical instrument of devastating power. His Hatsu channels music and rhythm into combat; by playing, he shapes aura into weaponized sound and conjured forms that respond to the melody. Battle Cantabile transforms him into a one-man orchestra of destruction. Bonolenov is cultured, artistic, and genuinely appreciates beauty in the world. He is thoughtful and often serves as a voice of perspective within the Troupe. He is loyal to the Spider's survival but maintains his own artistic principles. He is a skilled performer in his own right, and his Nen abilities reflect a deep understanding of aesthetics and form.

premadeCharacters.name: Kortopi
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#12) and a forger of impossible precision. Kortopi is short and has a mouse-like quality to his appearance, which belies his technical genius. His Nen category is Conjuration, and his signature Hatsu, Gallery Fake, allows him to create perfect duplicates of any object he touches—paintings, weapons, artifacts, money. The duplicates are indistinguishable from originals; only Kortopi can identify them. Gallery Fake makes him invaluable for heists and forgery operations; the Troupe uses him to replicate stolen goods, create false evidence, and acquire duplicate artifacts. Kortopi is quiet, technical, and focused on his craft. He does not engage in philosophical discussion about theft the way Chrollo does; he simply enjoys the challenge of perfect replication. He is loyal to the Troupe out of practical attachment—they value his skill and protect him in return. Arc validity: A1-A7; dies in the Dark Continent expedition (A8) when Hisoka murders him as part of his war on the Troupe.

premadeCharacters.name: Kalluto Zoldyck
premadeCharacters.description: A member of the Phantom Troupe (#4) and the youngest Zoldyck heir to join the Spider. Kalluto is beautiful in a delicate, angular way, with long silver hair and the refined bearing of his family's training. Unlike his brothers, Kalluto is graceful and artistic—his Nen category is Manipulation, and his signature Hatsu, Dance of the Serpent's Bite, manifests through conjured paper martial arts. His technique involves creating origami-like weapons and constructs from pure aura, which he commands with serpentine fluidity. Kalluto joined the Troupe after the Yorknew arc, becoming the Spider's #4 member and filling the vacancy left by Hisoka's departure. Kalluto is skilled, devoted, and carries the Zoldyck family's assassin training into the Troupe's ranks. Unlike his siblings who view assassination as a vocation, Kalluto views the Troupe as family—perhaps the only family that has ever truly wanted him. He is loyal to Chrollo's leadership and to the Spider's collective purpose. His background is Zoldyck-Trained Assassin, reflecting his heritage. Arc validity: A5+, joining as #4 after Yorknew's conclusion.
traits: Hatsu: Dance of the Serpent's Bite

premadeCharacters.name: Silva Zoldyck
premadeCharacters.description: The current head of the Zoldyck household and the father of Killua, Illumi, Milluki, Kalluto, and Alluka. Silva is an imposing figure—tall, muscular, with white hair and piercing eyes that reflect decades of assassination training. He is a Nen Master with a Transmuter's category, and his signature Hatsu, Twin Orbs, allows him to conjure and control two spheres of condensed aura that orbit his body. These orbs can be launched as projectiles or rotated for defense; they are both weapon and shield. Silva is the architect of the Zoldyck family's modern power structure and discipline. He is emotionally restrained, professional, and absolutely committed to the family's survival and reputation. He treats his children with a mixture of pride and ruthlessness—they are heirs to a legacy, and they must prove themselves worthy of that legacy. Silva made a dramatic exception for Killua, publicly releasing him from the family after Gon's rescue mission, allowing his son the freedom to choose his own path. This act of paternal concern marks a rare moment of softness in an otherwise relentless life.

premadeCharacters.name: Zeno Zoldyck
premadeCharacters.description: The patriarch of the Zoldyck family and Silva's father, Zeno is an elderly man of extraordinary vitality and power. Despite his age, he maintains the bearing and physicality of a master warrior. Zeno is a Nen Master with a Transmuter's category, and his signature technique, Dragon Lance (or Dragon Head / Dragon Dive), manifests as a large, scaled dragon constructed from his aura. The dragon obeys his mental commands, striking with devastating force and defending him from harm. Zeno is calm, philosophical, and deeply observant. He views people through the lens of genealogy and legacy—a person's bloodline determines their potential, and the Zoldycks are among the world's finest bloodlines. He genuinely respects worthy opponents and finds joy in testing himself against strong foes. In the Chimera Ant arc, Zeno participates in the palace invasion, fighting alongside the Hunter Association forces. He is formidable, tactical, and ultimately pragmatic. Despite his age, he remains among the world's strongest Nen users.

premadeCharacters.name: Kikyo Zoldyck
premadeCharacters.description: The matriarch of the Zoldyck household and the mother of Killua, Illumi, Milluki, Kalluto, and Alluka. Kikyo is elegant and sharp, with white hair styled carefully and an air of refined authority. She is a Nen Adept with a Manipulator's category, and her Hatsu remains in development, focused on the principles of Manipulation. As matriarch, Kikyo oversees the day-to-day operations of the household, manages the staff, and trains the younger heirs in assassination technique and Nen fundamentals. She is strict, demanding, and genuinely cares for her children—though her expression of that care manifests as relentless pressure to improve and perform. Kikyo is the emotional center of the household, though her emotions are always expressed through the lens of duty and legacy. She is loyal to Silva's vision for the family and trusts his judgment implicitly.

premadeCharacters.name: Milluki Zoldyck
premadeCharacters.description: The armorer and technology specialist of the Zoldyck household, Milluki is the second Zoldyck heir and perhaps the most unusual member of his family. While his siblings embraced the family's assassination legacy, Milluki chose the path of technological innovation and remote combat. He is soft-bodied, wears civilian clothing, and spends most of his time in his room designing weapons and torture devices for the family's operations. Milluki is a Nen Practitioner with a Manipulator's category, and his Hatsu remains in development, focused on Manipulation. His primary strength lies not in direct combat but in creating tools that give others advantages. He designs drones, surveillance systems, and remote-controlled devices that amplify the family's operational reach. Milluki is socially awkward, more comfortable with machinery than people, and views the world through a lens of efficiency and innovation. He is loyal to the family but in a detached way; his true passion is engineering. His background is Civilian Prodigy, reflecting his unconventional role within the martial family.

premadeCharacters.name: Alluka Zoldyck
premadeCharacters.description: The youngest Zoldyck heir and the bearer of a power that transcends normal Nen classification. Alluka is innocent, kind-hearted, and fundamentally different from her ruthless siblings. She is kept isolated in the family home, rarely seen by outsiders, her existence treated as a secret by the household. The reason: Alluka is the host body of Nanika, a mysterious entity that may be Nen-sentient, may be an artificial construct, or may be something far stranger. Alluka's Hatsu, Nanika's Wish, allows her to grant wishes with reality-warping power—but each wish comes at an escalating cost. The first wish is nearly free; each subsequent wish demands exponentially more in exchange (death of innocents, loss of memories, transformation of the world). The rules are incomprehensible to outsiders and understood only by Alluka/Nanika. Alluka is the only person who can grant Killua's wish—to save Gon's life during the Election arc. Playing as Alluka is profoundly different from playing as other characters: you do not choose the cost of your power; the wish-granter determines what must be paid. Her category is Specialist; her tier is tier-exempt (her power is not hers, and its rules are unique). Arc validity: hidden through A6; revealed and playable A7+. Her background is Civilian Prodigy.

premadeCharacters.name: Canary
premadeCharacters.description: A young butler of the Zoldyck household and one of the few staff members whose face is regularly seen by visitors. Canary is delicate and soft-spoken, with a gentle demeanor that masks genuine strength. She is a Nen Initiate with an Emitter's category, and her Hatsu remains in development, focused on the principles of Emission. Canary's role is to greet visitors at the Testing Gate and assist with household management. During the Zoldyck Family arc, she faces a profound moral conflict when Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio arrive to retrieve Killua—she is duty-bound to prevent their entry, yet she genuinely cares for Killua's wellbeing and wishes him to be free of the family's oppressive structure. This conflict defines her character arc: the tension between loyalty to an institution and compassion for an individual. Canary is kind, conscientious, and slowly awakening to the possibility that there might be more to life than serving a family that treats her as property. Her background is Meteor City Survivor, indicating her connection to the city of stateless people where many Zoldyck staff originated.

premadeCharacters.name: Gotoh
premadeCharacters.description: The head butler of the Zoldyck household and a fierce protector of the family's interests. Gotoh is elderly, dignified, and carries himself with the bearing of a master servant—perfectly trained, perfectly composed, and utterly loyal. He is a Nen Adept with an Emitter's category, and his signature Hatsu, Coin Bullets, allows him to conjure coins and fire them as projectiles with devastating force. He channels his aura into the coins, making them move at bullet speed and strike with lethal precision. Gotoh's technique is elegant and economical; a single coin can be lethal. Gotoh serves as the gatekeeper of the family, greeting visitors and defending the household against intrusion. He is respectful, professional, and genuinely cares for his position and the family he serves. During the Zoldyck Family arc, he assists Gon and his friends in traversing the Testing Gate, respecting their determination even as he tests their strength. Gotoh is wise, measured, and has likely forgotten more about Nen and combat than most users will ever know. Arc validity: A1-A7; dies in the Dark Continent expedition (A8, offscreen) when Hisoka hunts down individuals connected to Chrollo.

premadeCharacters.name: Tsubone
premadeCharacters.description: An elderly butler of the Zoldyck household and a master of ancient Nen techniques. Tsubone is small, aged, and moves with surprising agility despite her years. She is a Nen Master with a Conjurer's category, and her signature Hatsu, Rider's High, allows her to conjure magnificent beast forms—horses, hawks, dragons, and other creatures—which she can ride and control. Each conjured beast grants her enhanced mobility and combat capability; she can summon different forms to suit different situations. Tsubone is professional, fierce, and utterly devoted to the Zoldyck family. She is one of the household's most powerful Nen users despite her age, and she serves as a mentor to the younger heirs, training them in combat and assassination technique. Tsubone speaks rarely, moves with purpose, and commands respect from everyone in the household. She is the kind of character whose quiet presence conveys absolute competence. Her age belies her strength; her stillness hides lethal capability.

premadeCharacters.name: Cheadle Yorkshire
premadeCharacters.description: A composed and meticulous figure in the Zodiacs' inner circle, serving as the Dog of the zodiac election council during the 13th Chairman's succession. Cheadle Yorkshire is a Licensed Hunter with a methodical approach to governance and bureaucracy. She possesses a quiet demeanor but commands absolute respect; her clinical precision in decision-making stems from her background as a Disease Hunter, trained to diagnose and contain outbreaks with surgical precision. Her Nen mastery is substantial, yet her true power lies in administrative authority and political negotiation. She develops her Hatsu within the Manipulation school, a discipline she is carefully learning. Cheadle represents order, duty, and the Hunter Association's institutional framework—she is the one who keeps records, enforces rules, and ensures decisions are documented. Her arc-7 prominence comes as Pariston's foil: where he plays games, she insists on principles. By the Election's close, she becomes the 14th Chairman, a position earned through competence rather than charisma. Her background is Licensed Hunter; her era begins on-stage at the Election (A7+).

premadeCharacters.name: Mizaistom Nana
premadeCharacters.description: The Ox of the Zodiacs and a Crime Hunter of considerable standing, Mizaistom Nana cuts an imposing figure despite his calm demeanor. He is a Nen Adept with natural affinity for Conjuration, having mastered his signature Hatsu—Cattle Bell—a technique that materializes harmonic conjured cards or charms that can transmit warnings, marshal followers, or coordinate across distance. His power is subtle, bureaucratic, and indispensable to the Association's operational stability. Mizaistom is measured, patient, and deeply embedded in the Association's institutional framework; he speaks only when necessary and carries the weight of administrative authority alongside combat capability. As a Crime Hunter, he has spent his career tracking organized crime networks, giving him a particular interest in information control and coordination. During the Election arc, he appears as one of the steady hands among the Zodiacs—not flashy, but impossibly reliable. His background is Licensed Hunter; his era begins clearly on-stage at the Election (A7+).

premadeCharacters.name: Kanzai
premadeCharacters.description: The Tiger of the Zodiacs, Kanzai is a Licensed Hunter whose approach to combat mirrors his zodiac nature—direct, fearless, and pouncing with calculated ferocity. He is a Nen Adept with a natural inclination toward Enhancement, allowing him to amplify his body's physical capabilities beyond human limits. His Hatsu remains in development, but he has committed his Nen practice to the Enhancement school, focusing on transmuting raw aura into overwhelming force. Kanzai is confident, unflinching in the face of danger, and carries himself with the bearing of a seasoned warrior. During the Election arc, he is present among the Zodiacs as one of the council's combat specialists—a heavyweight voice in decisions involving physical confrontation. He speaks plainly, without pretense, and respects direct opponents more than political schemers. His tiger-nature extends to his temperament: he can be both protective of those he considers allies and ruthlessly predatory toward those marked as threats. His background is Licensed Hunter; his era begins on-stage at the Election (A7+).

premadeCharacters.name: Pyon
premadeCharacters.description: The Rabbit of the Zodiacs, Pyon is a Licensed Hunter whose demeanor carries the quick-footed vigilance of her animal aspect. She is a Nen Adept with natural affinity for Emission, allowing her to project aura at distance with remarkable control and precision. Her Hatsu is still in development—she has committed to the Emission school but has not yet locked in a singular signature technique, preferring instead to maintain flexibility across multiple projected-aura applications. Pyon's voice is calm and measured; she listens more than she speaks, but when she does speak, others lean in to hear. She carries herself with a gentle confidence that belies her combat prowess. During the Election arc, she appears among the Zodiacs as a voice for pragmatism—quick-thinking, adaptive, and focused on finding the path of least resistance that still achieves the necessary outcome. Her background is Licensed Hunter; her era begins on-stage at the Election (A7+).

premadeCharacters.name: Botobai Gigante
premadeCharacters.description: The Dragon of the Zodiacs, Botobai Gigante is a Nen Master and a Licensed Hunter whose power and bearing command immediate respect. As a Terrorist Hunter, he has built his career on confronting some of the world's most dangerous individuals and organizations. He is a Nen Master with natural mastery of Enhancement, allowing him to push his body and aura to superhuman extremes. His Developing Hatsu builds on Enhancement principles, exploring how far aura amplification can be driven. Botobai is an older man with a broad, formidable frame; his presence carries weight and authority. He speaks with the confidence of someone who has faced genuine existential threats and survived. During the Election arc, he is one of the Zodiacs' elder statesmen, representing the council's toughest combat capability. His relationship with Pariston Hill is one of mutual respect tinged with friction—Botobai appreciates direct power, while Pariston represents an order of complexity that can frustrate the straightforward. His background is Licensed Hunter; his era begins on-stage at the Election (A7+).

premadeCharacters.name: Gel
premadeCharacters.description: The Snake of the Zodiacs, Gel is a Licensed Hunter whose quiet demeanor masks lethal chemical mastery. She is a Nen Adept with natural affinity for Transmutation, allowing her to reshape her aura into various compounds and venoms. Her signature power—the Poison Arm—manifests as aura transmuted into caustic, acidic substances that can corrode flesh, bone, and matter with terrifying speed. She channels this poison through her limbs, turning her touch into a weapon of dissolution. Gel is reserved, focused, and speaks rarely; when she does, her words carry precision and economy. She is comfortable with silence and observation. During the Election arc, she stands among the Zodiacs as a specialist in subtle, devastating power—the kind of threat that doesn't announce itself until the damage is irreversible. Her relationship with Pariston is one of clinical assessment; she can appreciate his strategic mind without being seduced by his charm. Her background is Licensed Hunter; her era begins on-stage at the Election (A7+).

premadeCharacters.name: Saccho Kobayakawa
premadeCharacters.description: The Horse of the Zodiacs, Saccho Kobayakawa is a Licensed Hunter and a Trouble Hunter by specialization—a career focused on resolving complex, dangerous situations that resist conventional resolution. He is a Nen Adept with natural affinity for Emission, allowing him to project and manipulate his aura at considerable range. His Hatsu remains in development, but his commitment to Emission principles gives him versatility in ranged combat and aura-projection applications. Saccho is an unassuming man with a calm demeanor and keen observational skills; he has the bearing of someone who has navigated countless compromises and conflicts. During the Election arc, he appears among the Zodiacs as a pragmatist whose experience in troubleshooting makes him valuable in complex negotiations. He tends to think several moves ahead, planning for contingencies. His background is Licensed Hunter; his era begins on-stage at the Election (A7+).

premadeCharacters.name: Ginta
premadeCharacters.description: The Sheep of the Zodiacs, Ginta is a Licensed Hunter whose nature mirrors his animal aspect—gentle on the surface but capable of remarkable strength when roused. He is a Nen Adept with natural affinity for Enhancement, allowing him to amplify his physical body and aura beyond normal human limits. His Hatsu remains in development, but his commitment to Enhancement principles gives him solid martial capability and the foundation for future signature techniques. Ginta carries himself with a quiet friendliness; he is approachable and easy to underestimate. During the Election arc, he appears among the Zodiacs as one of the steadier hands—not flashy, not political, simply reliable and competent. There is a solidity to him that others gravitate toward, an unshakeable presence that anchors the council during heated debates. His background is Licensed Hunter; his era begins on-stage at the Election (A7+).

premadeCharacters.name: Saiyu
premadeCharacters.description: The Monkey of the Zodiacs, Saiyu is a Licensed Hunter whose demeanor is deceptively cheerful and approachable. He is a Nen Adept with mastery of Conjuration, having developed a signature Hatsu called the Three Monkeys—a technique that manifests conjured aura constructs representing the ancient proverb: see no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil. These constructs serve as sensory blocks, communication barriers, or perceptual manipulators. Saiyu is clever, witty, and possesses a ready smile for any occasion. During the Election arc, he moves easily among the Zodiacs, maintaining warm relationships across the council. His camaraderie seems genuine, his interest in others authentic. However, there are depths to Saiyu that remain hidden, secrets beneath the affable surface. His background is Licensed Hunter; his era begins on-stage at the Election (A7+). Note: Saiyu harbors a concealed betrayal—he is the zodiac mole, a revelation that lies well outside the player-facing world state.

premadeCharacters.name: Cluck
premadeCharacters.description: The Chicken of the Zodiacs, Cluck is a Licensed Hunter whose sharp wit and incisive commentary make her a memorable presence in council meetings. She is a Nen Adept with natural affinity for Manipulation, allowing her to influence and direct aura and intent at distance. Her Hatsu remains in development, but her commitment to Manipulation principles gives her formidable capability for strategic aura-work. Cluck does not hesitate to voice disagreement, challenge poor logic, or call out political maneuvering when she sees it. She is opinionated without being reckless—her critiques come from genuine concern for the Association's welfare. During the Election arc, she appears among the Zodiacs as one of the council's conscience-keepers, the one most likely to ask difficult questions and demand accountability. Her relationship with Pariston is one of mutual respect tinged with a healthy skepticism; she admires his brilliance while remaining unswayed by his charm. Her background is Licensed Hunter; her era begins on-stage at the Election (A7+).

premadeCharacters.name: Ging Freecss
premadeCharacters.description: The Boar of the Zodiacs, Ging Freecss is a Licensed Hunter and a double-star Ruins Hunter, one of the Association's most decorated specialists. He is Gon's father—a name that haunts his son's entire journey through the world. Ging is a Nen Master whose Nen category remains functionally unrevealed; his true power lies in his ability to replicate techniques on sight, a Specialist capability that allows him to copy and execute nearly any Nen application he observes. This adaptability makes him unpredictably dangerous; opponents never know which of his opponent's own techniques he might turn against them. Ging is charismatic, brilliant, and profoundly self-interested. He speaks with infectious enthusiasm about his passions—archaeology, exploration, Nen theory—but his personal relationships are secondary to his work. He left Gon as an infant to pursue his Hunter career; the fact that his son spent years chasing his shadow is something Ging acknowledges with mild affection but no apparent guilt. During the Election arc, he appears as the mysterious Zodiac whose identity had been kept hidden until the election's later stages. Meeting his son face to face becomes a quiet culmination of Gon's original quest. His background is Civilian Prodigy; his era begins clearly visible only at the Election (A7+), though he has existed off-stage since the beginning.

premadeCharacters.name: Pariston Hill
premadeCharacters.description: The Rat of the Zodiacs and the Association's vice-chairman, Pariston Hill is a Nen Master whose true Nen category and signature Hatsu remain unrevealed—and he prefers it that way. His weapon is not aura or technique but intellect, charisma, and an unsettling smile that suggests he knows far more than he's saying. Pariston's power lies in his ability to manipulate people and situations, to see ten moves ahead and enjoy the game of positioning players like chess pieces. He is beautiful, charming, and utterly amoral—a man who views the world as an elaborate puzzle to be solved for personal entertainment. His relationship with Netero is one of profound mutual affection and sharp rivalry; they respect each other as equals while constantly testing and challenging one another. After Netero's death, Pariston's interest shifts to the Succession War and to watching how his colleagues navigate the chaos of the Election. He is a Specialist by nature—not through Nen classification but through his unique and unreplicable approach to power. His background is Hunter Association Staff; his era spans the Election (A7) and beyond (A8). Note: Pariston develops friction with multiple Zodiacs, particularly Cheadle (his foil in governance philosophy) and Botobai (who respects direct power over games).

premadeCharacters.name: Melody
premadeCharacters.description: A Licensed Hunter and a Nen Practitioner whose gentle soul belies the trauma scarring her past. Melody is an Emitter with a signature Hatsu called Song of Healing—a technique that manifests her aura as pure, harmonic sound waves capable of mending wounds, soothing pain, and restoring damaged tissue. Her music is said to be achingly beautiful, a balm to the grieving and broken. Yet Melody knows suffering intimately. Years before her employment in Yorknew's mafia underworld, she encountered the Phantom Troupe's Feitan Portor during his rampage. The experience left her physically scarred and emotionally fractured; the wounds never fully healed. She carries visible damage—burn marks, twisted tissue—across her body, reminders of Rising Sun's agony. Despite this, Melody chose a path of pacifism, taking a vow early in her Nen practice: she would never use her power to harm, only to heal. This vow—the Pacifist's Edge—is both her greatest limitation and her greatest source of strength. She serves the Nostrade family during the Yorknew arc as Neon's attendant and bodyguard. She is the gentlest person in that mafia circle, a conscience in an amoral world. Her background is Licensed Hunter; her Vow defines her arc-4 availability.

premadeCharacters.name: Basho
premadeCharacters.description: A Mafia Community Member and a Nen Practitioner of considerable artistic sensibility, Basho is a Conjurer whose signature Hatsu is called the Great Haiku—a technique that manifests his aura as living poetry, written words and conceptual constructs drawn from classical Japanese verse. His conjured haiku-form aura can encode instructions, create barriers, or manipulate perception through the power of poetic language itself. Basho is a contemplative man with a passion for traditional arts and literature; he views his Nen practice as an extension of his spiritual discipline. He is refined, patient, and carries himself with the bearing of a scholar. During the Yorknew arc, he serves the Nostrade family as an attendant and enforcer, a position that requires him to marry his artistic sensitivity with brutal pragmatism. Basho is one of the few members of the mafia circle who retains any aesthetic sense, who views beauty and function as compatible rather than opposed. His background is Mafia Community Member; his arc-4 role is Nostrade-adjacent.

premadeCharacters.name: Neon Nostrade
premadeCharacters.description: A Civilian Prodigy and a Specialist whose Nen power comes unbidden, arising without formal training or discipline. Neon Nostrade is the daughter of Light Nostrade, a rising power in Yorknew's mafia underworld. She possesses a signature Hatsu called Lovely Ghostwriter—a technique that allows her to divine the future through written oracles, manifestations of her aura appearing as ghostly text or spectral messages that reveal possible outcomes. Her power is real, unpredictable, and immensely valuable; her family's entire fortune rises on the strength of her divinations. Yet Neon is untrained in Nen, unaware of even basic principles, and fundamentally vulnerable. She is spoiled, entitled, and casually cruel—the product of wealth and indulgence. During the Yorknew arc, she is simultaneously the most protected and most endangered person in the Nostrade circle, surrounded by bodyguards including Kurapika. The arc concludes with her power catastrophically failing; by the arc's end, her Lovely Ghostwriter ceases to function permanently. Her background is Civilian Prodigy; her arc-4 presence is Yorknew-centered, and her power loss marks her unavailability in later arcs. She represents the danger of unearned, inexplicable ability—a girl caught between her family's exploitation and genuine peril.

premadeCharacters.name: Zepile
premadeCharacters.description: A Mafia Community Member and a non-combat specialist in forgery, appraisal, and social engineering, Zepile is an Undivined Nen user who has never awakened his potential—and he is perfectly content remaining that way. His strength lies not in aura or combat but in his ability to read people, craft convincing falsehoods, and navigate the criminal underworld's social networks. He is an honest forger in a world of dishonest ones; he takes pride in his craft and delivers exactly what he promises. During the Yorknew arc, he can serve as a companion for non-combat focused players, offering access to the mafia underworld through social channels rather than martial ones. Zepile is charming, quick-witted, and genuinely likable—a rarity among criminals. He is clever without being ruthless, ambitious without being cutthroat. His background is Mafia Community Member; he represents the possibility of meaningful play without Nen awakening, a reminder that the world's power structure has room for those who navigate it through intellect and charm rather than aura-based combat.

The Known World.name: The Known World
The Known World.basicInfo: The civilized world of six continents surrounding Lake Mobius, home to the Hunter Association, the mafia networks, great nation-states, and the Zoldyck family's estate. Though believed by the public to encompass all known lands, the Known World is in truth a small subcontinent within the vast interior waters of Lake Mobius—a secret guarded at the highest levels of power. Here flourish the Hunter Exam circuit, Heavens Arena's towering trials, the grand auction houses of Yorknew, the royal intrigues of East Gorteau, and the fortress of Kukuroo Mountain. Every cobblestone bears the weight of ambition, conspiracy, and untold power struggles.

Greed Island.name: Greed Island
Greed Island.basicInfo: A physical island masquerading as the world's most exclusive and costly video game, accessible only through enchanted game cartridges that bind body and soul to the Nen-construct realm itself. Within its shores, the rules of the game are absolute law—an economy built on spell cards, treasure hunts, and impossible challenges that shape reality as surely as they shape the map. Players find themselves trapped between paradise and prison, where every victory grants new powers and every defeat may cost everything. The settled lands offer towns and merchant rows, while the wilds teem with monsters and treasure beyond measure.

The Dark Continent.name: The Dark Continent
The Dark Continent.basicInfo: The vast and lethal realm beyond Lake Mobius, a world that dwarfs the Known World in both scale and danger. Here sail the great expeditions aboard vessels like the Black Whale, navigating treacherous voyage waters toward forbidden shores where the Five Calamities roam—threats of such magnitude that they dwarf even the mightiest Nen masters. The Dark Continent has swallowed every major expedition in recorded history; those few who return are forever changed by what they witnessed. This realm remains largely unmapped and unknowable, a frontier where human power and knowledge find their limits. Note: Content describing the Dark Continent's interior and the outcomes of the current expedition represents speculative continuation beyond the published manga source material.

Whale Island & Southern Seas.name: Whale Island & Southern Seas
Whale Island & Southern Seas.basicInfo: A temperate archipelago of modest islands scattered across warm, fishing-rich waters in the southern reaches of the Known World. Rocky coves give way to forested interiors, with Whale Island itself serving as the region's geographical anchor—a rocky homeland dotted with modest villages, dense forests yielding to open cliffs that overlook the harbor. The sea breeze carries salt and the cries of gulls; small wooden boats and fishing nets dominate the harbors. Simple folk—fishermen, farmers, and hunters of modest skill—make their livelihoods here, their lives far removed from the ambitions of the distant Hunter Association.

The Exam Circuit.name: The Exam Circuit
The Exam Circuit.basicInfo: A sprawling region encompassing the scattered stages of the Hunter Exam's annual crucible—a landscape of deadly trials disguised as natural or constructed obstacles. Rolling wetlands choked with fog and amphibious horrors give way to preserved forests housing wild beasts, towering trick towers of ancient stone, volcanic islands teeming with fauna, and concealed examination halls. The region is less a unified geography than a collection of death traps strategically positioned to test candidates; each location brutalizes aspirants differently. The atmosphere is one of bureaucratic cruelty cloaked in mystery—thousands perish annually to feed the Association's hunger for proven talent.

Republic of Padokea.name: Republic of Padokea
Republic of Padokea.basicInfo: A mountainous nation in the central reaches of the Known World, dominated by the imposing silhouette of Kukuroo Mountain—a peak both tourist attraction and impenetrable fortress. Lush lowlands and managed estates give way to dense forest and treacherous slopes; the architecture is a mix of humble farming villages and ornate—but carefully guarded—family compounds. The air carries the scent of earth and old money; locals move with careful courtesy, aware that the greatest danger often wears a smile. The Zoldyck family's presence casts a long shadow over regional politics, though officially the nation maintains plausible deniability of their control.

Arena City.name: Arena City
Arena City.basicInfo: A sprawling metropolis built around a singular obsession: the 251-floor Heavens Arena, a towering monument to martial prowess and Nen-fueled combat. Skyscrapers crowd the skyline in service to this central structure; the streets throb with the energy of fighters from every corner of the world, each seeking fortune, renown, or simple survival. The air reeks of sweat, ambition, and blood; districts shift from glittering upper-floor lodgings to grimy fighter housing to neon-soaked red-light quarters where anything can be wagered. The Arena's pull is magnetic and terrible—those who enter often consume themselves in pursuit of victory.

Yorknew & Environs.name: Yorknew & Environs
Yorknew & Environs.basicInfo: An upscale metropolitan region dominated by Yorknew City, the financial and cultural heart of the mafia underworld's legitimate face. Sprawling architecture blends old wealth with new ostentation; the city hosts the legendary underground auction during peak season, drawing collectors and crime lords from every continent. Beyond the city's glittering facade lie suburban estates, a sprawling necropolis housing the relics of the ancient past, and the tightly controlled Lingon Airport—gateway for those with the right credentials. The atmosphere oscillates between jeweled decadence and the subtle menace of families who smile while calculating your worth in body parts.

Mitene Union.name: Mitene Union
Mitene Union.basicInfo: A paradoxical realm of green pastoral lands and hidden industrial horror. The public face is one of isolationist tranquility—the NGL's verdant valleys and traditional villages, deliberately sealed from outside corruption by law and fierce cultural pride. But beneath this bucolic mask lies a darker history: the colony nests of Chimera Ants, the ruins of industrialist schemes, the fortress-nation of East Gorteau with its royal palace and intricate court politics. The border checkpoints are stern and unforgiving; those permitted entry find themselves in a land where the written law contradicts the lived truth at every turn.

Swardani City.name: Swardani City
Swardani City.basicInfo: An ancient, prestigious metropolis that serves as the seat of the Hunter Association's global authority. Grand governmental buildings intermix with libraries, hospitals, and research institutions—architecture that whispers of institutional power held aloft by tradition and bureaucracy. At the city's heart stands the colossal World Tree, a living monument of unknown origin whose upper reaches remain perpetually mysterious. The atmosphere is one of careful order undergirded by terrible knowledge; the Association's reach extends into every corner, and those who work here understand they serve an organization far older and stranger than any nation-state.

Kakin Empire.name: Kakin Empire
Kakin Empire.basicInfo: A rising imperial power expanding its influence across the Known World through wealth, strategic positioning, and ruthless ambition. The royal capital sprawls with ornate palace architecture and merchant quarters, its harbor teeming with merchant vessels and military transports. The empire projects strength and centralized authority; marble monuments celebrate its ascendance, while the underside—slave labor, political executions, court intrigue—remains hidden behind marble facades. Kakin's wealth is immense but its stability rests upon a knife's edge of succession politics and the whims of an aging emperor.

Greed Island — Settled Lands.name: Greed Island — Settled Lands
Greed Island — Settled Lands.basicInfo: The inhabited portion of Greed Island, where towns cluster and commerce flows according to the rules of the Nen-construct game. Towns and merchant row buildings dot a landscape of rolling terrain and managed settlements, their aesthetics hovering between video-game artificiality and dreamlike solidity—buildings shimmer with spell-card enchantments, NPCs move with unsettling mechanical friendliness, and the sky has the quality of painted canvas. Spell shops line the streets; price halls display impossible treasures; harbors host player fleets. The atmosphere is one of gamified paradise: endless opportunity, rigorous rule-enforcement, and the constant hum of players scheming for advantage.

Greed Island — Wilds.name: Greed Island — Wilds
Greed Island — Wilds.basicInfo: The untamed portion of Greed Island, where the game's monster encounters run wild and treasure lies beyond the reach of casual players. Barren wastes stretch across scorched earth studded with bandit camps and creature lairs; volcanic peaks loom over twisted terrain; the boundary between 'navigable wilderness' and 'instant death' is horrifyingly blurred. The sky here feels closer, the air thicker with danger; footprints appear and vanish with unnatural speed. Few players venture here willingly; those who do understand they are gambling with not merely their in-game avatar but their material survival, as death in the wilds can manifest as very real trauma or catatonia.

Lake Mobius — The Voyage.name: Lake Mobius — The Voyage
Lake Mobius — The Voyage.basicInfo: The vast interior waters of Lake Mobius, officially unknown to the public but traversed by the Black Whale and her sister vessels in the grand expeditions. A seemingly endless expanse of dark water, whirlpools of mysterious origin, and strange atmospheric phenomena that defy mapping. The waters themselves are said to be home to creatures of impossible scale; the sky above shifts between day and night in unpredictable rhythms. The Black Whale cuts across these waters like a floating city—a 200,000-passenger vessel carrying royalty, Nen masters, ancient secrets, and internecing politics that make the vessel as treacherous as any exterior threat. To sail Lake Mobius is to accept that one may never return.

The New Shore.name: The New Shore
The New Shore.basicInfo: The speculative territory beyond Lake Mobius and the Black Whale's voyage—a forbidden landing place representing the edge of human exploration and the threshold of the unknown. Ancient ruins dot the beachhead; the soil seems to pulse with a presence that predates human civilization; the air carries strange spores and electromagnetic disturbances that confound instruments. What lies in the interior remains unmapped, but early landing parties report landscapes that contradict all known biology. This region represents the absolute frontier of the Dark Continent—where the Five Calamities roam and every step forward risks permanent alteration of flesh and mind. NOTE: Content describing The New Shore and its interior represents speculative continuation beyond the published source material; outcomes of exploration and detailed calamity encounters remain unknown.

lowAttributeTraits.strength: You have weak raw power. Physical abilities and Enhancement-category techniques suffer from your frail musculature. You strain visibly when exerting force; heavy weapons and shields tire you quickly.
lowAttributeTraits.agility: You have sluggish reflexes. Combat and evasion skills depend on your torpid movements. You dodge slowly and strike with lumbering intent; fast opponents routinely outmaneuver you.
lowAttributeTraits.endurance: You have brittle constitution. Your body tires easily, and injuries linger. You fatigue quickly in sustained exertion; wounds bleed freely and healing takes longer than it should.
lowAttributeTraits.intellect: You have a scattered mind. Tactics, analysis, and strategic skills crumble under complexity. You struggle to see patterns, miss obvious solutions, and freeze when plans must shift.
lowAttributeTraits.willpower: You have a leaky aura. Nen concentration eludes you; your aura flickers like a failing flame. Ten requires constant effort, Zetsu is unreliable, and Nen abilities drain you faster than they should.
lowAttributeTraits.presence: You have a hollow authority. Social skills falter beneath your timid gaze. Others ignore you instinctively; intimidation rings hollow, persuasion lands gently, and deception crumbles under scrutiny.

Ten.name: Ten
Ten.description: The foundational aura technique: maintaining the protective envelope of your life force around your body at all times. Mastery of Ten allows a Nen user to sustain their aura as a constant, invisible shield against harm. A skilled practitioner of Ten becomes almost untouchable to those without Nen mastery.

Zetsu.name: Zetsu
Zetsu.description: The art of complete aura suppression and concealment: sealing your life force entirely to become invisible to other Nen users and to hide your presence. While Zetsu is active, you gain stealth and cannot be sensed by aura detection. However, this suppression leaves you defenseless against Nen techniques and any incoming damage bypasses your aura guard entirely.

Ren.name: Ren
Ren.description: Aura amplification through conscious expansion: opening your aura envelope fully to maximize your combat output and physical power. Activating Ren grants a significant boost to damage and ability effectiveness but drains your aura reserves steadily while the technique is maintained. Masters of Ren can overwhelm opponents through sheer aura intensity.

Hatsu.name: Hatsu
Hatsu.description: The projection of your aura into a unique personal technique reflecting your spirit and nature. Hatsu is the true art of Nen mastery—the ability to create and manifest your own signature ability drawn from your willpower. Your facility with Hatsu depends on your native Nen category, with off-category techniques suffering efficiency loss and strain.

Enhancement.name: Enhancement
Enhancement.description: The Enhancer's gift: infusing your aura into your body and objects to amplify their natural properties. Enhancement hardens your muscles, sharpens your reflexes, and strengthens whatever you touch. This is the most direct and efficient path of Nen, turning the body itself into a weapon of devastation.

Transmutation.name: Transmutation
Transmutation.description: The art of changing your aura's fundamental qualities to mimic or create new properties. Transmutation allows a Nen user to reshape their aura into something wholly different: fire, electricity, liquid, or abstract forces. A master of Transmutation can replicate the effects of external phenomena entirely through aura manipulation.

Conjuration.name: Conjuration
Conjuration.description: The power to materialize permanent or semi-permanent objects from pure aura. Conjuration requires immense mental discipline and memorization of the object's structure. A skilled Conjurer can summon weapons, tools, or artifacts that exist as long as their aura sustains them. Breaking a conjured item or dispelling it wastes the aura instantly.

Emission.name: Emission
Emission.description: The technique of projecting and controlling your aura away from your body. Emission allows you to hurl aura blasts, create distance attacks, and maintain aura in the world independently. Masters of Emission strike from afar with lethal precision, their aura obeying their will even as it separates from their flesh.

Manipulation.name: Manipulation
Manipulation.description: The ability to control and command objects or beings with your aura once it has touched them. Manipulation transforms your willpower into invisible strings that obey your consciousness. A skilled Manipulator can animate puppets, restrain enemies, or seize control of the battlefield through sheer force of intellect.

Specialization.name: Specialization
Specialization.description: The most enigmatic category of Nen: unique powers that defy the other five principles and operate by their own mysterious rules. Specialists transcend the normal hexagon of Nen and are governed by conditions, vows, and personal limitations that unlock abilities beyond normal understanding. A Specialist's power is as unpredictable as it is potent.

Martial Arts.name: Martial Arts
Martial Arts.description: Disciplined training in unarmed combat, striking, and physical technique. Martial Arts grants mastery over your body as a weapon, teaching you how to channel your strength through proper form and striking patterns. A skilled martial artist can fell opponents with their bare hands; combined with Nen enhancement, they become unstoppable forces.

Weapon Mastery.name: Weapon Mastery
Weapon Mastery.description: Proficiency with swords, axes, spears, and other martial implements. Weapon Mastery teaches you how to handle any blade or blunt instrument with speed and precision, extending your striking range and damage. A master of weapons turns their tool into an extension of their intent.

Assassination Techniques.name: Assassination Techniques
Assassination Techniques.description: Specialized training in lethal strikes, vital targeting, and disabling wounds. Assassination Techniques grant you knowledge of weak points in anatomy and the precision to strike them with deadly intent. You can incapacitate or eliminate targets quickly and quietly, turning combat into surgical execution.

Stealth.name: Stealth
Stealth.description: The art of moving unseen and unheard through any environment. Stealth teaches you how to control your footfalls, manage shadows and sightlines, and blend seamlessly into surroundings. A skilled practitioner can walk through crowded areas unnoticed or traverse enemy territory unseen.

Acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
Acrobatics.description: Mastery of movement, tumbling, and physical control through the air and over obstacles. Acrobatics grants you balance, coordination, and the ability to perform impossible feats of movement. You can scale walls, flip over hazards, and dodge incoming attacks with breathtaking grace.

Perception.name: Perception
Perception.description: Keen awareness of your surroundings and heightened sensitivity to detail. Perception allows you to notice hidden clues, track movement, and sense danger before it arrives. A skilled observer can read a room in seconds and extract meaning from the smallest tells.

Tracking.name: Tracking
Tracking.description: The skill of following trails, reading signs, and pursuing targets across any terrain. Tracking teaches you to interpret footprints, scents, disturbances in vegetation, and behavioral patterns. A master tracker can follow prey across deserts, forests, and cities alike.

Survival.name: Survival
Survival.description: Knowledge of wilderness navigation, shelter building, foraging, and enduring harsh conditions. Survival grants you the ability to sustain yourself in remote or dangerous environments through resourcefulness and toughness. You can thrive where others would perish.

First Aid.name: First Aid
First Aid.description: Medical knowledge of wound treatment, poison remediation, and emergency care. First Aid allows you to stabilize dying allies, restore health to the injured, and counter common afflictions. A skilled healer can snatch victory from the jaws of death.

Tactics.name: Tactics
Tactics.description: Strategic thinking, battle analysis, and combat planning that exploits enemy weaknesses. Tactics grants you the ability to read battles, predict opponent moves, and coordinate group efforts. A skilled tactician can win against superior numbers through clever positioning and timing.

Negotiation.name: Negotiation
Negotiation.description: Mastery of persuasion, compromise, and finding mutual benefit in dialogue. Negotiation allows you to broker deals, defuse tensions, and win concessions through words alone. A skilled negotiator can extract value from any conversation.

Intimidation.name: Intimidation
Intimidation.description: The art of projecting threat, dominance, and killing intent to compel obedience through fear. Intimidation grants you the ability to cow opponents into submission without violence. A master of intimidation can break wills through presence alone.

Deception.name: Deception
Deception.description: Mastery of lies, misdirection, and social manipulation. Deception allows you to craft believable falsehoods, read what others want to hear, and exploit trust for advantage. A skilled deceiver can run complex cons and turn enemies against one another.

Gambling.name: Gambling
Gambling.description: Expertise in games of chance, probability calculation, and reading opponents at cards and dice. Gambling teaches you probability theory, tells, and bluffing technique. A skilled gambler can win fortunes through intellect or lose everything through hubris.

Engineering.name: Engineering
Engineering.description: Knowledge of mechanics, construction, trap design, and invention. Engineering allows you to build structures, repair broken equipment, and create traps that exploit physics and ingenuity. A skilled engineer can turn simple materials into complex mechanisms of utility or destruction.

Nen-Unawakened.name: Nen-Unawakened
Nen-Unawakened.description: Your aura nodes remain sealed. You cannot access Nen in any form, and your aura pool stays dormant near zero. This state marks those unaware of Nen's existence, common before Hunter training or awakening. Your potential lies dormant, waiting for the catalyst that will open your inner gates.
Nen-Unawakened.quirk: Aura nodes are closed and sealed. The character cannot use any Nen ability, skill, or technique—Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu, all are beyond reach. Aura bar remains near zero. A narrative trigger (forced aura awakening, guided Ten initiation, or violent Nen exposure) can swap this trait for Nen Initiate in play.

Nen Initiate.name: Nen Initiate
Nen Initiate.description: Your aura nodes have been opened; you have learned the foundational technique of Ten. You can now maintain a steady aura state and hold basic Nen energy, though advanced applications remain beyond your reach. This is the threshold where the invisible world reveals itself.
Nen Initiate.quirk: Aura +30, Ten skill +2. You can hold Ten (the default meditative aura state). You are newly baptized in Nen and vulnerable to advanced practitioners, but the door has opened.

Nen Practitioner.name: Nen Practitioner
Nen Practitioner.description: You have mastered the foundational Nen techniques and are combat-capable. You can hold Ten reliably, apply Ren for amplified output, and channel basic Hatsu. You are a trained Nen user—not yet elite, but formidable in the eyes of the untrained.
Nen Practitioner.quirk: Aura +60, Ten +4, Ren +3, Hatsu +2. You can execute basic Nen combat and maintain sustained aura applications. Ren drains aura per turn in prolonged use; Hatsu abilities draw 10–20% per activation.

Nen Adept.name: Nen Adept
Nen Adept.description: You have refined your Nen to professional mastery. Your aura is vast, your control exquisite, and advanced applications like Gyo and Shu respond to your will. You are among the world's elite—a hunter of legendary standing capable of feats the average person cannot fathom.
Nen Adept.quirk: Aura +100, Ten +6, Ren +5, Hatsu +4, Zetsu +3. You can execute sophisticated aura techniques: Gyo (aura sight), Shu (object coating), In (concealment), and Ken (full defensive guard). One advanced-application ability is unlocked at character creation (chosen from Tier A: Gyo, Shu, In, Ken, Ko, or Ryu).

Nen Master.name: Nen Master
Nen Master.description: You stand among the world's apex—a living legend whose aura is nearly bottomless and whose command of Nen transcends mortal limitation. You wield advanced applications as easily as breathing and can shape reality itself through your Hatsu. Few walk this earth; fewer still reach this pinnacle.
Nen Master.quirk: Aura +150, Ten +8, Ren +7, Hatsu +6, Zetsu +5. You command all Tier A applications flawlessly: Gyo, Shu, In, Ken, Ko, Ryu, and En (aura field). Two advanced-application abilities are unlocked at character creation. Your Hatsu is legendary; your limitations are self-imposed.

Enhancer.name: Enhancer
Enhancer.description: Your Water Divination showed the water overflowing—the sign of an Enhancer. You possess raw physical prowess and the ability to amplify yourself and objects beyond their normal limits. Your Nen flows easily into your body and surroundings, making you the strongest combatant on any field. The hexagon rule governs your reach: your enhancement is full-strength in itself and adjacent categories (Transmutation, Emission), strong in distant categories (Conjuration, Manipulation), and nearly impossible in Specialization.
Enhancer.quirk: Enhancement +4 (native), Transmutation +3, Emission +3, Conjuration +2, Manipulation +2, Specialization +0. Your Nen specializes in amplification of self and objects. Transmutation and Emission are within reach; Conjuration and Manipulation are harder; Specialization techniques are nearly impossible to perform and require enormous effort. The hexagon dictates your efficiency: opposite-category Hatsu (e.g., a Conjurer's trap) suffers visible strain if you attempt it.

Transmuter.name: Transmuter
Transmuter.description: Your Water Divination showed the taste changing—a Transmuter's sign. You can alter the properties of your aura and objects, reshaping Nen into new forms and functions. Your techniques flow with creativity and deception; you bend the rules of reality itself. Adjacent categories (Enhancement, Conjuration) yield readily to your will; distant ones (Emission, Specialization) require great effort; opposite-category Nen (Manipulation) resists your touch severely.
Transmuter.quirk: Transmutation +4 (native), Enhancement +3, Conjuration +3, Emission +2, Specialization +1, Manipulation +1. Your Nen transforms and reshapes. Enhancement and Conjuration come naturally; Emission and Specialization are taxing; Manipulation is hostile to your nature and nearly impossible without exhaustion. The hexagon enforces this: you are a creative liar, and your Nen reflects that flexibility—except where it refuses.

Conjurer.name: Conjurer
